message.content:
Explore two subsystems of the Ventus GPGPU (a Chisel/Scala RISC-V GPGPU hardware project).

PART A — CTA scheduler (workgroup/warp dispatch): directory `ventus/src/cta/` and docs `docs/cta_scheduler/`.
Read excerpts of:
- ventus/src/cta/cta_scheduler.scala (top: cta_scheduler_top)
- ventus/src/cta/allocator.scala
- ventus/src/cta/resource_table.scala
- ventus/src/cta/wg_buffer.scala
- ventus/src/cta/cu_interface.scala
- ventus/src/cta/utils.scala
- ventus/src/pipeline/CTA2warp.scala (the SM-side interface that receives dispatched warps)
Also skim docs/cta_scheduler/Top.md, Allocator.md, Resouce table.md, wg_buffer.md.

PART B — Cache hierarchy: `ventus/src/L1Cache/` and `ventus/src/L2cache/`.
Read excerpts of:
- ventus/src/L1Cache/ICache/ICache.scala + ICacheMSHR.scala + ICacheParameters.scala
- ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala + DCacheParameters.scala + DCacheWSHR.scala
- ventus/src/L1Cache/ShareMem/ShareMem.scala + BankConflictArbiter.scala (shared/local memory)
- ventus/src/L1Cache/L1TagAccess.scala + L1MSHR.scala + L1Interfaces.scala + L1Cache2L2Arbiter.scala
- ventus/src/L2cache/Scheduler.scala + MSHR.scala + BankedStore.scala + Parameters.scala + Configs.scala

For each module report:
1. Main class/module name + 1-2 sentence purpose.
2. For CTA: the dispatch flow (host → wg_buffer → resource_table → allocator → CU), and what a WG/WF is.
3. For caches: how L1I/L1D/SharedMem relate to the SM pipeline (coreReq/coreRsp/memReq/memRsp), and how L2 Scheduler connects. Note MSHR and WSHR roles.

Be concise and factual. Only report module names you actually see. Do not invent anything.

46	class io_rt2dealloc extends Bundle with ctainfo_alloc_to_cuinterface
47	
48	/**
49	 * Resource table cache writer in allocator
50	 * At posedge(alloc_en), the allocation result is updated to rtcache of `alloc_cuid`.
51	 * When alloc_en == true, the rtcache of `alloc_cuid` is locked and cannot be written with a new rt_result.
52	 * At other moments, rt_result is accepted and written to corresponding CU rtcache
53	 * @see the main state machine of allocator
54	 * @see doc/allocator.md
55	 *
56	 * @param NUM_RESOURCE: total amount of the hardware resource managed by this module
57	 * @param NUM_RT_RESULT: number of the results given by resource table, also the number of rtcache entries
58	 * @note This module is currently implemented as almost-pure combinational logic
59	 * @todo Check if the combinational logic path is too long
60	 */
61	class rtcache_writer(NUM_RESOURCE: Int, NUM_RT_RESULT: Int = CONFIG.RESOURCE_TABLE.NUM_RESULT) extends Module {
62	  val io  = IO(new Bundle {
63	    val rt_result = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cache(NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_RT_RESULT = NUM_RT_RESULT)))
64	    val alloc_en = Input(Bool())
65	    val alloc_sel = Input(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RT_RESULT).W))
66	    val alloc_cuid = Input(UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU).W))
67	    val alloc_size = Input(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W))
68	    val alloc_rawdata = Input(new datatype_rtcache(NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_RT_RESULT = NUM_RT_RESULT))
69	    val rtcache_wr_en = Output(Bool())
70	    val rtcache_wr_cuid = Output(UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU).W))
71	    val rtcache_wr_data = Output(new datatype_rtcache(NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_RT_RESULT = NUM_RT_RESULT))
72	  })
73	
74	  val alloc_en_r1 = RegNext(io.alloc_en)
75	  val alloc_wr = !alloc_en_r1 && io.alloc_en  // posedge(io.alloc_en)
76	
77	  // if the allocator is not in STATE_ALLOC, it is ok to get a rt_result, else:
78	  // - if this module is busy with a new allocation action, it is not ready to get a rt_result
79	  // - if the CU of rt_result is in STATE_ALLOC, it is not ready to get this rt_result
80	  io.rt_result.ready := !io.alloc_en || (!alloc_wr && (io.rt_result.bits.cu_id =/= io.alloc_cuid))
81	
82	  // =
83	  // Main function: rtcache_wr = Mux(cond, alloc, rt_result)
84	  // =
85	
86	  io.rtcache_wr_en := io.rt_result.fire || alloc_wr
87	  when(alloc_wr) {
88	    io.rtcache_wr_cuid := io.alloc_cuid
89	    for(i <- 0 until NUM_RT_RESULT) {
90	      io.rtcache_wr_data.size(i) := io.alloc_rawdata.size(i) - Mux(i.U === io.alloc_sel, io.alloc_size, 0.U)
91	      assert(io.alloc_rawdata.size(io.alloc_sel) >= io.alloc_size)
92	    }
93	  } .elsewhen(io.rt_result.fire) {
94	    io.rtcache_wr_data.size := io.rt_result.bits.size
95	    io.rtcache_wr_cuid := io.rt_result.bits.cu_id
96	  } .otherwise {
97	    io.rtcache_wr_data.size := DontCare
98	    io.rtcache_wr_cuid := DontCare
99	  }
100	}

148	  val writer_sgpr = Module(new rtcache_writer(NUM_RESOURCE = CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX, NUM_RT_RESULT = NUM_RT_RESULT))
149	  val writer_vgpr = Module(new rtcache_writer(NUM_RESOURCE = CONFIG.WG.NUM_VGPR_MAX, NUM_RT_RESULT = NUM_RT_RESULT))
150	  when(writer_lds.io.rtcache_wr_en)  { rtcache_lds(writer_lds.io.rtcache_wr_cuid)   := writer_lds.io.rtcache_wr_data  }
151	  when(writer_sgpr.io.rtcache_wr_en) { rtcache_sgpr(writer_sgpr.io.rtcache_wr_cuid) := writer_sgpr.io.rtcache_wr_data }
152	  when(writer_vgpr.io.rtcache_wr_en) { rtcache_vgpr(writer_vgpr.io.rtcache_wr_cuid) := writer_vgpr.io.rtcache_wr_data }
153	  writer_lds.io.rt_result  <> io.rt_result_lds
154	  writer_sgpr.io.rt_result <> io.rt_result_sgpr
155	  writer_vgpr.io.rt_result <> io.rt_result_vgpr
156	
157	  // =
158	  // Auxiliary function 2: WG slot & WF slot recorder
159	  // =
160	
161	  // resource table of WG/WF slot
162	  val wgslot = RegInit(VecInit.fill(NUM_CU)(0.U(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT.W)))
163	  val wfslot = RegInit(VecInit.fill(NUM_CU)(0.U(log2Ceil(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WF_SLOT+1).W)))
164	
165	  val wgslot_id = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT).W)) // generated WG slot ID
166	  val wgslot_id_1H = Reg(UInt(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT.W)) // generated WG slot ID, 1-hot encoded
167	
168	  // =
169	  // Main FSM - define
170	  // =
171	
172	  object FSM extends ChiselEnum {
173	    val IDLE, CU_PREFER, RESOURCE_CHECK, ALLOC, REJECT= Value
174	  }
175	  val fsm_next = Wire(FSM())
176	  val fsm = RegNext(fsm_next, FSM.IDLE)
177	  val fsm_r1 = RegNext(fsm, FSM.IDLE)
178	
179	  // =
180	  // Main FSM - actions
181	  // =
182	
183	  // used in sub-fsm RESOURCE_CHECK, presenting the resource check result in this cycle
184	  val resource_check_result = Wire(Vec(RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP, Bool()))
185	
186	  // IDLE -> CU_PREFER: get WG from wg_buffer
187	  val wg = RegEnable(io.wgbuffer_wg_new.bits, io.wgbuffer_wg_new.fire)
188	  io.wgbuffer_wg_new.ready := WireInit(fsm === FSM.IDLE)
189	
190	  // used in sub-fsm RESOURCE_CHECK, counting how many CU have already been checked
191	  val cu_cnt = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_CU + RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP).W))
192	  switch(fsm) {
193	    is(FSM.CU_PREFER) {
194	      // CU_PREFER -> RESOURCE_CHECK: clear cu_cnt
195	      cu_cnt := Mux(fsm_next === FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK, 0.U, DontCare)
196	    }
197	    is(FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK) {
198	      // RESOURCE_CHECK: cu_cnt += step
199	      cu_cnt := cu_cnt + RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U
200	    }
201	  }
202	
203	  // used in sub-fsm CU_PREFER, presenting the most preferred CU of this WG
204	  // used in sub-fsm RESOURCE_CHECK, presenting the CU that being checked this cycle
205	  //                                 after this sub-fsm exit, it becomes the CU that finally being selected
206	  val cu = RegInit((NUM_CU-1).U(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W))
207	  val cu_next = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU + RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP).W))
208	
209	  // used in sub-fsm RESOURCE_CHECK, if rtram of currently-being-checked CU is updated, in which case we should check again
210	  def cu_check(cu_updated: UInt, cu_now: UInt, cu_step: UInt): Bool = {
211	    val cu_begin = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W), cu_now)
212	    val cu_end_raw = cu_now + cu_step - 1.U
213	    val cu_end = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W), Mux(cu_end_raw >= NUM_CU.U, cu_end_raw - NUM_CU.U, cu_end_raw)) // Round
214	    Mux(cu_end > cu_begin, cu_updated >= cu_begin && cu_updated <= cu_end, cu_updated <= cu_end || cu_updated >= cu_begin)
215	  }
216	  val resource_check_repeat =
217	    (io.rt_result_lds.fire  && cu_check(io.rt_result_lds.bits.cu_id , cu, RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U)) ||
218	    (io.rt_result_sgpr.fire && cu_check(io.rt_result_sgpr.bits.cu_id, cu, RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U)) ||
219	    (io.rt_result_vgpr.fire && cu_check(io.rt_result_vgpr.bits.cu_id, cu, RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U))
220	
221	  cu_next := cu // switch default
222	  switch(fsm) {
223	    is(FSM.CU_PREFER) {
224	      // FSM.CU_PREFER: generate preferred CU ID. Currently we prefer CU after the last allocated CU
225	      cu_next := cu + 1.U
226	    }
227	    is(FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK) {
228	      when(fsm_next === FSM.ALLOC) {
229	        // RESOURCE_CHECK -> ALLOC:  generated selected CU ID
230	        cu_next := cu + PriorityEncoder(resource_check_result.asUInt)
231	      } .otherwise {
232	        // RESOURCE_CHECK -> REJECT: DontCare
233	        // RESOURCE_CHECK: if(cache_updated) {do nothing} else {CU step}
234	        cu_next := Mux(resource_check_repeat, cu, cu + RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U)
235	      }
236	    }
237	  }
238	  val cu_next_rounded = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W), Mux(cu_next >= NUM_CU.U, cu_next - NUM_CU.U, cu_next)) // Round
239	  cu := cu_next_rounded
240	
241	  // resource check result generating, combinational logic
242	  val resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_lds  = Wire(Vec(RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RT_RESULT).W)))
243	  val resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_sgpr = Wire(Vec(RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RT_RESULT).W)))
244	  val resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_vgpr = Wire(Vec(RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RT_RESULT).W)))
245	  for(i <- 0 until RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP) {
246	    val cuid = Mux(cu + i.U >= NUM_CU.U, cu + i.U - NUM_CU.U, cu + i.U)
247	    val result_line_lds  = Wire(Vec(NUM_RT_RESULT, Bool()))
248	    val result_line_sgpr = Wire(Vec(NUM_RT_RESULT, Bool()))
249	    val result_line_vgpr = Wire(Vec(NUM_RT_RESULT, Bool()))
250	    for(j <- 0 until NUM_RT_RESULT) { // higher rt cache line has higher priority
251	      result_line_lds(j)  := rtcache_lds(cuid).size(j)  >= wg.num_lds
252	      result_line_sgpr(j) := rtcache_sgpr(cuid).size(j) >= wg.num_sgpr
253	      result_line_vgpr(j) := rtcache_vgpr(cuid).size(j) >= wg.num_vgpr
254	    }
255	
256	    // Priority Encoder, MSB has the highest priority
257	    resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_lds(i)  := PriorityMux(result_line_lds.reverse , (NUM_RT_RESULT-1 to 0 by -1).map(_.asUInt))
258	    resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_sgpr(i) := PriorityMux(result_line_sgpr.reverse, (NUM_RT_RESULT-1 to 0 by -1).map(_.asUInt))
259	    resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_vgpr(i) := PriorityMux(result_line_vgpr.reverse, (NUM_RT_RESULT-1 to 0 by -1).map(_.asUInt))
260	
261	    resource_check_result(i) := result_line_lds.asUInt.orR && result_line_sgpr.asUInt.orR && result_line_vgpr.asUInt.orR &&
262	                               (!wgslot(cuid).andR) && (CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WF_SLOT.U - wfslot(cuid) >= wg.num_wf)
263	  }
264	
265	  // wg slot id generation
266	  // RESOURCE_CHECK: DontCare
267	  // RESOURCE_CHECK -> REJECT: DontCare
268	  // RESOURCE_CHECK -> ALLOC : This WG's slot ID in the selected CU
269	  when(fsm === FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK) {
270	    wgslot_id := PriorityEncoder(~wgslot(cu_next_rounded))
271	    wgslot_id_1H := PriorityEncoderOH(~wgslot(cu_next_rounded))
272	  }
273	
274	  // resource table cache line select
275	  // RESOURCE_CHECK: DontCare
276	  // RESOURCE_CHECK -> REJECT: DontCare
277	  // RESOURCE_CHECK -> ALLOC : The resource table cache line selection results for three kinds of resources
278	  val rtcache_lds_sel  = RegEnable(resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_lds(PriorityEncoder(resource_check_result.asUInt)) , fsm === FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK)
279	  val rtcache_sgpr_sel = RegEnable(resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_sgpr(PriorityEncoder(resource_check_result.asUInt)), fsm === FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK)
280	  val rtcache_vgpr_sel = RegEnable(resource_check_result_rtcache_sel_vgpr(PriorityEncoder(resource_check_result.asUInt)), fsm === FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK)
281	
282	  // ALLOC tasks
283	  val alloc_task_rt = Wire(Bool())          // send alloc request to Resource table
284	  val alloc_task_wgram2 = Wire(Bool())      // send wgram read request to wgbuffer
285	  val alloc_task_cuinterface = Wire(Bool()) // send newly-allocated WG info to CU interface
286	  val alloc_task_ok = alloc_task_rt && alloc_task_wgram2 && alloc_task_cuinterface
287	
288	  // ALLOC task0: wgslot & wfslot update, always finishes in the first cycle of FSM.ALLOC
289	  io.rt_dealloc.ready := !(fsm === FSM.ALLOC && fsm =/= fsm_r1) || (io.rt_dealloc.bits.cu_id === cu)
290	  val wgslot_alloc_bitmask = Mux(fsm === FSM.ALLOC && fsm =/= fsm_r1, wgslot_id_1H, 0.U)
291	  val wgslot_dealloc_bitmask = Mux(io.rt_dealloc.fire, UIntToOH(io.rt_dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id), 0.U)
292	  val wfslot_alloc_num = Mux(fsm === FSM.ALLOC && fsm =/= fsm_r1, wg.num_wf, 0.U)
293	  val wfslot_dealloc_num = Mux(io.rt_dealloc.fire, io.rt_dealloc.bits.num_wf, 0.U)
294	  val cu_tmp = Mux(fsm === FSM.ALLOC && fsm =/= fsm_r1, cu, io.rt_dealloc.bits.cu_id)
295	  wgslot(cu_tmp) := wgslot(cu_tmp) & (~wgslot_dealloc_bitmask).asUInt | wgslot_alloc_bitmask
296	  wfslot(cu_tmp) := wfslot(cu_tmp) + wfslot_alloc_num - wfslot_dealloc_num
297	
298	  // ALLOC task1: rtcache update, always finishes in the first cycle, then waiting for FSM.ALLOC ends
299	  writer_lds.io.alloc_en := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC)
300	  writer_lds.io.alloc_rawdata := rtcache_lds(cu)
301	  writer_lds.io.alloc_size := wg.num_lds
302	  writer_lds.io.alloc_cuid := cu
303	  writer_lds.io.alloc_sel := rtcache_lds_sel
304	  writer_sgpr.io.alloc_en := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC)
305	  writer_sgpr.io.alloc_rawdata := rtcache_sgpr(cu)
306	  writer_sgpr.io.alloc_size := wg.num_sgpr
307	  writer_sgpr.io.alloc_cuid := cu
308	  writer_sgpr.io.alloc_sel := rtcache_sgpr_sel
309	  writer_vgpr.io.alloc_en := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC)
310	  writer_vgpr.io.alloc_rawdata := rtcache_vgpr(cu)
311	  writer_vgpr.io.alloc_size := wg.num_vgpr
312	  writer_vgpr.io.alloc_cuid := cu
313	  writer_vgpr.io.alloc_sel := rtcache_vgpr_sel
314	
315	  // ALLOC task2: resource table allocation request
316	  val alloc_task_rt_reg = RegInit(false.B)
317	  io.rt_alloc.valid := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC) && !alloc_task_rt_reg
318	  io.rt_alloc.bits.cu_id := cu
319	  io.rt_alloc.bits.wg_slot_id := wgslot_id
320	  io.rt_alloc.bits.num_lds := wg.num_lds
321	  io.rt_alloc.bits.num_sgpr := wg.num_sgpr
322	  io.rt_alloc.bits.num_vgpr := wg.num_vgpr
323	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) { io.rt_alloc.bits.wg_id.get := wg.wg_id.get }
324	  alloc_task_rt_reg := Mux(fsm === FSM.ALLOC, alloc_task_rt_reg || (io.rt_alloc.fire && !alloc_task_ok), false.B)
325	  alloc_task_rt := alloc_task_rt_reg || io.rt_alloc.fire
326	
327	  // ALLOC task 3: send wg info to the next pipeline stage, which will finally send it to CU interface
328	  val alloc_task_cuinterface_reg = RegInit(false.B)
329	  val cuinterface_buf = Module(new Queue(new io_alloc2cuinterface, entries=1, pipe=true))
330	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.valid := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC) && !alloc_task_cuinterface_reg
331	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.cu_id := cu
332	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.wg_slot_id := wgslot_id
333	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.num_wf := wg.num_wf
334	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.lds_dealloc_en := (wg.num_lds =/= 0.U)
335	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.sgpr_dealloc_en := (wg.num_sgpr =/= 0.U)
336	  cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.vgpr_dealloc_en := (wg.num_vgpr =/= 0.U)
337	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {cuinterface_buf.io.enq.bits.wg_id.get := wg.wg_id.get}
338	  alloc_task_cuinterface_reg := Mux(fsm === FSM.ALLOC, alloc_task_cuinterface_reg || (cuinterface_buf.io.enq.fire && !alloc_task_ok), false.B )
339	  alloc_task_cuinterface := alloc_task_cuinterface_reg || cuinterface_buf.io.enq.fire
340	  io.cuinterface_wg_new <> cuinterface_buf.io.deq
341	
342	  // ALLOC task 4: wgram2 read request
343	  // REJECT task
344	  val alloc_task_wgram2_reg = RegInit(false.B)
345	  io.wgbuffer_result.valid := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC || fsm === FSM.REJECT) && !alloc_task_wgram2_reg
346	  io.wgbuffer_result.bits.accept := (fsm === FSM.ALLOC)
347	  io.wgbuffer_result.bits.wgram_addr := wg.wgram_addr
348	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) { io.wgbuffer_result.bits.wg_id.get :=  wg.wg_id.get }
349	  alloc_task_wgram2_reg := MuxLookup(fsm.asUInt, false.B)(Seq(
350	    FSM.ALLOC.asUInt  -> (alloc_task_wgram2_reg || (io.wgbuffer_result.fire && !alloc_task_ok)),
351	    FSM.REJECT.asUInt -> (alloc_task_wgram2_reg || (io.wgbuffer_result.fire && !alloc_task_ok)),
352	  ))
353	  alloc_task_wgram2 := alloc_task_wgram2_reg || io.wgbuffer_result.fire
354	
355	  // =
356	  // Main FSM - state transition
357	  // =
358	
359	  // fsm next state logic, combinational
360	  fsm_next := FSM.IDLE  // default
361	  switch(fsm) {
362	    is(FSM.IDLE) {
363	      fsm_next := Mux(io.wgbuffer_wg_new.fire, FSM.CU_PREFER, fsm)
364	    }
365	    is(FSM.CU_PREFER) {
366	      fsm_next := FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK
367	    }
368	    is(FSM.RESOURCE_CHECK) {
369	      fsm_next := MuxCase(fsm, Seq(
370	        resource_check_repeat -> fsm,
371	        resource_check_result.asUInt.orR -> FSM.ALLOC,
372	        (cu_cnt + RESOURCE_CHECK_CU_STEP.U >= NUM_CU.U) -> FSM.REJECT,
373	      ))
374	    }
375	    is(FSM.REJECT) {
376	      fsm_next := Mux(io.wgbuffer_result.fire, FSM.IDLE, fsm)
377	    }
378	    is(FSM.ALLOC) {
379	      fsm_next := Mux(alloc_task_ok, FSM.IDLE, fsm)
380	    }
381	  }
382	
383	}

1	package cta

3	import chisel3._
4	import chisel3.util._
5	import chisel3.experimental.dataview._
6	import cta.utils.RRPriorityEncoder
7	import top.parameters.{CTA_SCHE_CONFIG => CONFIG}

10	  val accept = Bool()   // true.B: it is ok to send this wg to CU.      false.B: rejected
11	  val wgram_addr = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_ENTRIES).W)
12	  val wg_id: Option[UInt] = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
13	}

15	class io_buffer2alloc(NUM_ENTRIES: Int = CONFIG.WG_BUFFER.NUM_ENTRIES) extends ctainfo_host_to_alloc {
16	  val wg_id: Option[UInt] = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
17	  val wgram_addr = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_ENTRIES).W)
18	}

20	class io_buffer2cuinterface extends Bundle with ctainfo_host_to_cu with ctainfo_host_to_cuinterface {
21	  val useless = UInt(1.W)
22	  val wg_id = UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)
23	}

25	/** WG buffer that receives WG info from host and select proper WG for allocator
26	 * Main function:
27	 * 1. Write new wg info from host into wgram. Proper address is selected in Round-Robin method.
28	 * 2. Select and send wg to allocator. Proper address is selected in Round-Robin method. Only necessary wg info is sent.
29	 * 3.1 If allocator accepts a wg, remaining info of that wg is sent to cu-interface.
30	 * 3.2 If allocator rejects a wg, that wg is allowed to be sent to allocator in the next turn.
31	 * @param NUM_ENTRIES wg buffer depth
32	 * @see doc/wg_buffer.md
33	 * @note DecoupledIO.ready outputs are not registered
34	 */
35	class wg_buffer(NUM_ENTRIES: Int = CONFIG.WG_BUFFER.NUM_ENTRIES) extends Module {
36	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
37	    val host_wg_new = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_host2cta))             // Get new wg from host
38	    val alloc_wg_new = DecoupledIO(new io_buffer2alloc(NUM_ENTRIES))    // Request allocator to determine if the given wg is ok to allocate
39	    val alloc_result = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_alloc2buffer()))      // Determination result from allocator
40	    val cuinterface_wg_new = DecoupledIO(new io_buffer2cuinterface)
41	  })
42	  val DEBUG = CONFIG.DEBUG
43	
44	  // =
45	  // wgram1(addr) stores wg information which is used by allocator
46	  // wgram2(addr) stores wg information which is used by CU-interface or CU
47	  //  wgram(addr) refers to the set of {wgram1(addr), wgram2(addr)}, not an actual hardware
48	  // wgram_valid(addr) stores if wg_ram(addr) is valid information
49	  // wgram_alloc(addr) stores if wg in wg_ram(addr) is now being processed by allocator
50	  // =
51	  class ram1datatype extends ctainfo_host_to_alloc{
52	    val wg_id = if(DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
53	  }
54	
55	  val wgram1 = Mem(NUM_ENTRIES, new ram1datatype)              // combinational/asynchronous-read memory
56	  val wgram2 = Mem(NUM_ENTRIES, new  io_buffer2cuinterface)    // combinational/asynchronous-read memory
57	  val wgram_valid = RegInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), 0.U)
58	  val wgram_alloc = RegInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), 0.U)
59	
60	  val wgram1_wr_data = Wire(new ram1datatype)
61	  val wgram2_wr_data = Wire(new io_buffer2cuinterface)
62	  wgram1_wr_data := io.host_wg_new.bits    // TODO: check if the connection is right
63	  wgram2_wr_data.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cu{}) :<= io.host_wg_new.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cu{})
64	  wgram2_wr_data.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cuinterface{}) :<= io.host_wg_new.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cuinterface{})
65	  wgram2_wr_data.wg_id := io.host_wg_new.bits.wg_id
66	  wgram2_wr_data.useless := 0.U
67	  dontTouch(wgram2_wr_data)
68	  // 出于未知原因，Verilator仿真时wgram2实际写入端口的第238bit总为1，这里使用一个无作用的信号置于第238bit处防止bug扩散
69	  // 若仿真表明第238bit恢复正常，可放心删除此信号
70	
71	  // Next preferred writable/readable address of wg_ram
72	  val wgram_wr_next = RRPriorityEncoder(~wgram_valid)
73	  val wgram1_rd_next = RRPriorityEncoder(wgram_valid & ~wgram_alloc)
74	
75	  val wgram_wr_act = Wire(Bool())          // Take a write operation to   wg_ram and wg_ram_valid
76	  val wgram1_rd_act = Wire(Bool())         // Take a read  operation from wg_ram1
77	
78	  // =
79	  // Main function 1
80	  // write new WG into wg_ram, host_wg_new interface
81	  // =
82	
83	  // new wg from host is accepted  <=>  wg info written into wg_ram(next_valid_wr_addr)
84	  //                               <=>  privious found valid writable address is consumed
85	  io.host_wg_new.ready := wgram_wr_next.valid // new wg from host is accepted  <=>  found a valid writable address in wg_ram
86	  wgram_wr_next.ready := io.host_wg_new.valid // previous found writable address is consumed  <=>  new wg from host available
87	
88	  // new wg available && writable address in wg_ram found  =>  write operation takes effect
89	  wgram_wr_act := wgram_wr_next.fire
90	  when(wgram_wr_act){
91	    wgram1.write(wgram_wr_next.bits, wgram1_wr_data)
92	    wgram2.write(wgram_wr_next.bits, wgram2_wr_data)
93	  }
94	
95	  // =
96	  // Main function 2
97	  // read WG info from wgram1, send them to allocator, alloc_wg_new interface
98	  // =
99	
100	  val alloc_wg_new_valid_r = RegInit(false.B)
101	  io.alloc_wg_new.valid := alloc_wg_new_valid_r
102	  alloc_wg_new_valid_r := Mux(wgram1_rd_act, true.B,
103	                          Mux(io.alloc_wg_new.ready, false.B, alloc_wg_new_valid_r))
104	
105	  // When to read new wg info for allocator? (valid == false) || (valid == ready == true)
106	  // No wg is waiting for being sent to allocator, or the only waiting wg is currently being sent to allocator
107	  wgram1_rd_next.ready := (!alloc_wg_new_valid_r || io.alloc_wg_new.ready)   // read operation is allowed
108	  wgram1_rd_act := wgram1_rd_next.fire                                      // read operation takes effect
109	
110	  val wgram1_rd_data = Wire(new ram1datatype)
111	  wgram1_rd_data := RegEnable(wgram1.read(wgram1_rd_next.bits), wgram1_rd_act)
112	  val wgram1_rd_data_addr = RegEnable(wgram1_rd_next.bits, wgram1_rd_act)
113	
114	  io.alloc_wg_new.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_alloc {}) :=
115	    wgram1_rd_data.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_alloc {})    // TODO: check if the connection is right
116	  io.alloc_wg_new.bits.wgram_addr := wgram1_rd_data_addr
117	  if(DEBUG) io.alloc_wg_new.bits.wg_id.get := wgram1_rd_data.wg_id.get
118	
119	  // =
120	  // Main function 3
121	  // read WG info from wgram2 and clear wgram when allocator requests
122	  // alloc_result & cuinterface_wg_new interface
123	  // =
124	
125	  val wgram_rd2_clear_act = Wire(Bool())
126	  val wgram_rd2_clear_addr = WireInit(io.alloc_result.bits.wgram_addr)
127	
128	  val cuinterface_new_wg_valid_r = RegInit(false.B)
129	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.valid := cuinterface_new_wg_valid_r
130	  cuinterface_new_wg_valid_r := Mux(wgram_rd2_clear_act, true.B,
131	                                Mux(io.cuinterface_wg_new.ready, false.B, cuinterface_new_wg_valid_r))
132	  val wgram2_rd_data_raw = WireInit(wgram2.read(wgram_rd2_clear_addr))
133	  val wgram2_rd_data = RegEnable(wgram2_rd_data_raw, wgram_rd2_clear_act)
134	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.bits := wgram2_rd_data
135	  dontTouch(wgram2_rd_data)
136	  // 出于未知原因，Verilator仿真时wgram2实际写入端口的第238bit总为1，这里使用一个无作用的信号useless置于第238bit处防止bug扩散
137	  // 若仿真表明第238bit恢复正常，可放心删除此信号
138	
139	  if(DEBUG) {
140	    val alloc_result_wgid = RegEnable(io.alloc_result.bits.wg_id.get, wgram_rd2_clear_act)
141	    val wgram_rd2_clear_act_r1 = RegNext(wgram_rd2_clear_act, false.B)
142	    when(wgram_rd2_clear_act_r1) {
143	      assert(wgram2_rd_data.wg_id === alloc_result_wgid)
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  // operation is allowed by internal of this Module when downstream datapath is not blocked: (valid == false) || (valid == ready == true)
148	  // operation is requested by external Module when (valid && allocation accepted)
149	  // operation takes effect <=> (allowed && requested)
150	  val wgram_rd2_clear_ready = !cuinterface_new_wg_valid_r || io.cuinterface_wg_new.ready   // clear is always allowed, just consider read wg_ram2
151	  wgram_rd2_clear_act := (io.alloc_result.fire && io.alloc_result.bits.accept) && wgram_rd2_clear_ready
152	
153	  val wgram_alloc_clear_ready = true.B
154	  val wgram_alloc_clear_act = io.alloc_result.fire && !io.alloc_result.bits.accept && wgram_alloc_clear_ready
155	  val wgram_alloc_clear_addr = WireInit(io.alloc_result.bits.wgram_addr)
156	
157	  io.alloc_result.ready := Mux(io.alloc_result.bits.accept, wgram_rd2_clear_ready, wgram_alloc_clear_ready)
158	
159	  // =
160	  // wg_ram_valid set and reset
161	  // =
162	
163	  val wgram_valid_setmask = WireInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), wgram_wr_act << wgram_wr_next.bits)
164	  val wgram_valid_rstmask = WireInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), wgram_rd2_clear_act << wgram_rd2_clear_addr)
165	  // Different set/reset request mustn't act on the same register
166	  // Mutual exclusivity of different write operations is guaranteed by wgram_valid and wgram_wr_next
167	  assert((wgram_valid_setmask & wgram_valid_rstmask).orR === false.B) // mutually exclusivity check
168	  wgram_valid := wgram_valid & ~wgram_valid_rstmask | wgram_valid_setmask
169	
170	  val wgram_alloc_rstmask1 = WireInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), wgram_wr_act << wgram_wr_next.bits)
171	  val wgram_alloc_rstmask2 = WireInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), wgram_alloc_clear_act << wgram_alloc_clear_addr)
172	  val wgram_alloc_setmask = WireInit(Bits(NUM_ENTRIES.W), wgram1_rd_act << wgram1_rd_next.bits)
173	  // Different set/reset request mustn't act on the same register
174	  // Mutual exclusivity of different write operations is guaranteed by wgram_valid and wgram_alloc
175	  assert((wgram_alloc_rstmask1 & wgram_alloc_rstmask2 & wgram_alloc_setmask).orR === false.B) // mutually exclusivity check
176	  wgram_alloc := wgram_alloc & ~wgram_alloc_rstmask1 & ~wgram_alloc_rstmask2 | wgram_alloc_setmask
177	}

8	/**
9	 * CU interface:
10	 * 1. split WG into WF and send them to CU one-by-one
11	 * 2. gather WF of WG. After all WF of a WG finish, send dealloc request to ResourceTable and report to Host
12	 * @see docs/cta_scheduler/CU_interface.md
13	 */
14	class cu_interface extends Module {
15	  val NUM_CU: Int = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU
16	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
17	    val init_ok = Output(Bool())    // indicate if this Module has finished its init
18	    val wgbuffer_wg_new = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_buffer2cuinterface))     // new WG info from WGram2
19	    val alloc_wg_new = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_alloc2cuinterface))         // new WG info from Allocator
20	    val rt_wg_new = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cuinterface))               // new WG info from ResourceTable
21	    val cu_wf_new = Vec(NUM_CU, DecoupledIO(new io_cuinterface2cu))           // new WF to CU
22	    val cu_wf_done = Vec(NUM_CU, Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_cu2cuinterface))) // WF that finishes its execution
23	    val rt_dealloc = DecoupledIO(new io_cuinterface2rt)                       // dealloc request to ResourceTable
24	    val host_wg_done = DecoupledIO(new io_cta2host)                           // report to host which WG has finished its execution
25	  })
26	  val NUM_WG_SLOT = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT
27	  val NUM_WF_MAX = CONFIG.WG.NUM_WF_MAX
28	  val NUM_LDS  = CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX
29	  val NUM_SGPR = CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX
30	  val NUM_VGPR = CONFIG.WG.NUM_VGPR_MAX
31	  val NUM_PDS  = CONFIG.WG.NUM_PDS_MAX
32	  val MEM_ADDR_WIDTH = CONFIG.GPU.MEM_ADDR_WIDTH
33	  val DEBUG = CONFIG.DEBUG
34	  class wftag_datatype extends Bundle {
35	    val wg_slot_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W)
36	    val wf_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WF_MAX).W)
37	  }
38	
39	  // =
40	  // Main function 1: gather WG info from Allocator, Resource table and WGram2
41	  // =
42	
43	  class cta_data extends Bundle with ctainfo_alloc_to_cuinterface with ctainfo_alloc_to_cu with ctainfo_host_to_cuinterface with ctainfo_host_to_cu {
44	    val wg_id = UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)
45	  }
46	  val fifo = Module(new Queue(new cta_data, 2))
47	
48	  if(DEBUG) {
49	    when(fifo.io.enq.fire) {
50	      assert(io.wgbuffer_wg_new.bits.wg_id === io.alloc_wg_new.bits.wg_id.get)
51	      assert(io.rt_wg_new.bits.wg_id.get === io.alloc_wg_new.bits.wg_id.get)
52	    }
53	  }
54	  // DecoupledIO 3-to-1
55	  io.wgbuffer_wg_new.ready := io.alloc_wg_new.valid && io.rt_wg_new.valid && fifo.io.enq.ready
56	  io.alloc_wg_new.ready := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.valid && io.rt_wg_new.valid && fifo.io.enq.ready
57	  io.rt_wg_new.ready := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.valid && io.alloc_wg_new.valid && fifo.io.enq.ready
58	  fifo.io.enq.valid := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.valid && io.alloc_wg_new.valid && io.rt_wg_new.valid
59	  fifo.io.enq.bits.wg_id := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.bits.wg_id
60	  fifo.io.enq.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cuinterface {}) := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.bits
61	  fifo.io.enq.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cu {}) := io.wgbuffer_wg_new.bits
62	  fifo.io.enq.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_alloc_to_cuinterface {}) := io.alloc_wg_new.bits
63	  fifo.io.enq.bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_alloc_to_cu {}) := io.rt_wg_new.bits
64	
65	  // =
66	  // Main function 2: split WG into WF
67	  // =
68	
69	  // the value of splitter_cnt means how many WF is waiting for being sent to CU
70	  // splitter_cnt==0 means no WF is waiting to be sent, we are waiting for the next WG
71	  val splitter_cnt = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_WF_MAX + 1).W))
72	  val splitter_lds_addr = WireInit(fifo.io.deq.bits.lds_base)
73	  val splitter_sgpr_addr = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_SGPR).W)) // sgpr base of WF, its value steps num_sgpr_per_wf every time
74	  val splitter_vgpr_addr = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_VGPR).W)) // vgpr base of WF, its value steps num_vgpr_per_wf every time
75	  val splitter_pds_addr = Reg(UInt(MEM_ADDR_WIDTH))        // pds  base of WF, its value steps num_pds_per_wf every time
76	  val splitter_load_new = (splitter_cnt === 0.U) && fifo.io.deq.valid   // A new WG will be loaded to splitter
77	  fifo.io.deq.ready := (splitter_cnt === 1.U) && io.cu_wf_new(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id).ready
78	
79	  splitter_cnt := MuxCase(0.U, Seq(
80	    (splitter_cnt =/= 0.U) -> Mux(io.cu_wf_new(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id).fire, splitter_cnt - 1.U, splitter_cnt),
81	    (splitter_load_new) -> (fifo.io.deq.bits.num_wf),
82	  ))
83	  splitter_sgpr_addr := MuxCase(splitter_sgpr_addr, Seq(
84	    splitter_load_new -> fifo.io.deq.bits.sgpr_base,
85	    io.cu_wf_new(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id).fire -> (splitter_sgpr_addr + fifo.io.deq.bits.num_sgpr_per_wf),
86	  ))
87	  splitter_vgpr_addr := MuxCase(splitter_vgpr_addr, Seq(
88	    splitter_load_new -> fifo.io.deq.bits.vgpr_base,
89	    io.cu_wf_new(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id).fire -> (splitter_vgpr_addr + fifo.io.deq.bits.num_vgpr_per_wf),
90	  ))
91	  splitter_pds_addr := MuxCase(splitter_pds_addr, Seq(
92	    splitter_load_new -> fifo.io.deq.bits.pds_base,
93	    io.cu_wf_new(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id).fire -> (splitter_pds_addr + fifo.io.deq.bits.num_pds_per_wf),
94	  ))
95	  assert(splitter_cnt <= 1.U || NUM_SGPR.U - splitter_sgpr_addr > fifo.io.deq.bits.num_sgpr_per_wf)
96	  assert(splitter_cnt <= 1.U || NUM_VGPR.U - splitter_vgpr_addr > fifo.io.deq.bits.num_vgpr_per_wf)
97	  assert(splitter_cnt === 0.U || fifo.io.deq.valid)
98	
99	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_CU) {
100	    io.cu_wf_new(i).valid := (splitter_cnt =/= 0.U) && (fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id === i.U)
101	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.viewAsSupertype(new ctainfo_host_to_cu {}) := fifo.io.deq.bits
102	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.pds_base := splitter_pds_addr
103	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.lds_base := splitter_lds_addr
104	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.sgpr_base := splitter_sgpr_addr
105	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.vgpr_base := splitter_vgpr_addr
106	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.wg_id := fifo.io.deq.bits.wg_id
107	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.num_wf := fifo.io.deq.bits.num_wf
108	    io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.wf_tag := { val wftag = Wire(new wftag_datatype)
109	      wftag.wg_slot_id := fifo.io.deq.bits.wg_slot_id
110	      wftag.wf_id := fifo.io.deq.bits.num_wf - splitter_cnt
111	      wftag.asUInt
112	    }
113	  }
114	
115	  // =
116	  // Main function 3: store WG info for finishing check and dealloc
117	  // =
118	
119	  // data that needed by WF_gather, dealloc, or Host
120	  class cta_data_1 extends Bundle {
121	    val num_wf = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WF_MAX+1).W) // Number of wavefront in this cta
122	    val wg_id = UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)
123	    val lds_dealloc_en = Bool()   // whether LDS needs dealloc. When num_lds==0, lds do not need dealloc
124	    val sgpr_dealloc_en = Bool()
125	    val vgpr_dealloc_en = Bool()
126	  }
127	  val wf_gather_ram = SyncReadMem(NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT, new cta_data_1)
128	  val wf_gather_ram_valid = if(DEBUG) Some(RegInit(VecInit.fill(NUM_CU, NUM_WG_SLOT)(false.B))) else None
129	  def global_wgslot_calc(cu: UInt, wgslot: UInt): UInt = {cu * NUM_WG_SLOT.U + wgslot}
130	
131	  when(splitter_load_new) {
132	    if(DEBUG) { (wf_gather_ram_valid.get)(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id)(fifo.io.deq.bits.wg_slot_id) := true.B}
133	    val wf_gather_ram_data = Wire(new cta_data_1)
134	    wf_gather_ram_data := fifo.io.deq.bits
135	    wf_gather_ram.write(global_wgslot_calc(fifo.io.deq.bits.cu_id, fifo.io.deq.bits.wg_slot_id), wf_gather_ram_data)
136	  }
137	
138	  // =
139	  // FSM: gather WF from CU, generate dealloc to Resource table, generate host_wg_done (Main function 4~6)
140	  // =
141	
142	  object FSM extends ChiselEnum {
143	    val GET_WF = Value    // receive WF_done from CU (arbiter), and read WF counter for how many WF of this WG has already finished
144	    val UPDATE = Value    // update WF counter. If all WF of this WG finished, try to send dealloc request and Host report
145	    val DEALLOC = Value   // if dealloc request or Host report wasn't sent successfully in FSM.UPDATE, try it again
146	  }
147	  val fsm = RegInit(FSM.GET_WF)
148	
149	  // =
150	  // Main function 4 (FSM action 1): gather WF from CU
151	  // =
152	
153	  // select a CU whose wf_done is valid
154	  val arb_inst = Module(new RRArbiter[io_cu2cuinterface](new io_cu2cuinterface, NUM_CU))
155	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_CU) { arb_inst.io.in(i) <> io.cu_wf_done(i) }
156	  arb_inst.io.out.ready := (fsm === FSM.GET_WF)
157	
158	  // get new info of wf_done
159	  val wf_cu_wire = arb_inst.io.chosen
160	  val wf_cu_reg = RegEnable(arb_inst.io.chosen, arb_inst.io.out.fire)
161	  val wf_wgslot_wire = arb_inst.io.out.bits.wf_tag.asTypeOf(new wftag_datatype).wg_slot_id
162	  val wf_wgslot_reg = RegEnable(wf_wgslot_wire, arb_inst.io.out.fire)
163	
164	  // WF counter of how many WF of a WG has finished, this should be init to all zero
165	  val wf_gather_cnt = SyncReadMem(NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WF_MAX+1).W))
166	  val init_wf_gather_cnt_idx = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT + 1).W))
167	  init_wf_gather_cnt_idx := Mux(init_wf_gather_cnt_idx === (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U, init_wf_gather_cnt_idx, init_wf_gather_cnt_idx + 1.U)
168	  io.init_ok := (init_wf_gather_cnt_idx === (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U)
169	
170	  // when a new wf_done req is received, read related WG info from SyncReadMem
171	  val wf_gather_cnt_read_data = wf_gather_cnt.read(global_wgslot_calc(wf_cu_wire, wf_wgslot_wire), arb_inst.io.out.fire)
172	  val wf_gather_ram_read_data = { // The read-out data will be used in the following several cycles, we need to hold the last read-out data
173	    val tmp = RegNext(arb_inst.io.out.fire, false.B)
174	    val data = wf_gather_ram.read(global_wgslot_calc(wf_cu_wire, wf_wgslot_wire), arb_inst.io.out.fire)
175	    Mux(tmp, data, RegEnable(data, tmp))
176	  }
177	
178	  // after finishing reading WG info of the new wf_done, update WF counter
179	  val wf_gather_finish = (wf_gather_cnt_read_data + 1.U === wf_gather_ram_read_data.num_wf)
180	  val wf_gather_cnt_write_addr = Mux(init_wf_gather_cnt_idx =/= (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U, init_wf_gather_cnt_idx, global_wgslot_calc(wf_cu_reg, wf_wgslot_reg))
181	  val wf_gather_cnt_write_data = Mux(init_wf_gather_cnt_idx =/= (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U, 0.U,
182	                                     Mux(wf_gather_finish, 0.U, wf_gather_cnt_read_data + 1.U))
183	  val wf_gather_cnt_write_en = (init_wf_gather_cnt_idx =/= (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U) || (fsm === FSM.UPDATE)
184	  when(wf_gather_cnt_write_en) {
185	    wf_gather_cnt.write(wf_gather_cnt_write_addr, wf_gather_cnt_write_data)
186	  }
187	  when(init_wf_gather_cnt_idx =/= (NUM_CU * NUM_WG_SLOT).U) {
188	    // do nothing now
189	  } .elsewhen(fsm === FSM.UPDATE) {
190	    if(DEBUG) {
191	      assert((wf_gather_ram_valid.get)(wf_cu_reg)(wf_wgslot_reg))
192	      (wf_gather_ram_valid.get)(wf_cu_reg)(wf_wgslot_reg) := !wf_gather_finish
193	    }
194	  }
195	
196	  // =
197	  // Main function 5 (FSM action 2): generate dealloc request to ResourceTable for newly finished WG
198	  // =
199	
200	  val rt_dealloc_ok = { val reg = RegInit(false.B)
201	    reg := Mux(fsm === FSM.UPDATE, io.rt_dealloc.fire, reg || io.rt_dealloc.fire)
202	    reg
203	  }
204	  io.rt_dealloc.valid := (fsm === FSM.UPDATE && wf_gather_finish) || (fsm === FSM.DEALLOC && !rt_dealloc_ok)
205	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.cu_id := wf_cu_reg
206	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id := wf_wgslot_reg
207	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.num_wf := wf_gather_ram_read_data.num_wf
208	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.lds_dealloc_en := wf_gather_ram_read_data.lds_dealloc_en
209	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.sgpr_dealloc_en := wf_gather_ram_read_data.sgpr_dealloc_en
210	  io.rt_dealloc.bits.vgpr_dealloc_en := wf_gather_ram_read_data.vgpr_dealloc_en
211	  if(DEBUG) { io.rt_dealloc.bits.wg_id.get := wf_gather_ram_read_data.wg_id }
212	
213	  // =
214	  // Main function 6 (FSM action 3): generate host_wg_done request for newly finished WG
215	  // =
216	
217	  val host_wg_done_ok = { val reg = RegInit(false.B)
218	    reg := Mux(fsm === FSM.UPDATE, io.host_wg_done.fire, reg || io.host_wg_done.fire)
219	    reg
220	  }
221	  io.host_wg_done.valid := (fsm === FSM.UPDATE && wf_gather_finish) || (fsm === FSM.DEALLOC && !host_wg_done_ok)
222	  io.host_wg_done.bits.wg_id := wf_gather_ram_read_data.wg_id
223	  io.host_wg_done.bits.cu_id := wf_cu_reg
224	
225	  // =
226	  // FSM state transition logic
227	  // =
228	
229	  fsm := MuxLookup(fsm.asUInt, FSM.GET_WF)(Seq(
230	    FSM.GET_WF.asUInt -> Mux(arb_inst.io.out.fire, FSM.UPDATE, fsm),
231	    FSM.UPDATE.asUInt -> MuxCase(FSM.DEALLOC, Seq(
232	      !wf_gather_finish -> FSM.GET_WF,
233	      (io.rt_dealloc.fire && io.host_wg_done.fire) -> FSM.GET_WF,
234	    )),
235	    FSM.DEALLOC.asUInt -> Mux(rt_dealloc_ok && host_wg_done_ok, FSM.GET_WF, fsm),
236	  ))
237	}

1	package cta.utils

3	/**
4	 * @see docs/cta_scheduler/Utilities.md
5	 */
6	
7	import chisel3._
8	import chisel3.util._
9	import scala.math.max

11	/** Round-Robin-Priority Binary Encoder
12	 * @param n: length of the input Bool-Vector
13	 * @IO out.fire: A valid encoding result is accepted by outer module, and priority should be updated in RR method
14	 */
15	class RRPriorityEncoder(n: Int, initsel: UInt = 0.U) extends Module {
16	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
17	    val in = Input(Vec(n, Bool()))
18	    val out = DecoupledIO(Output(UInt(log2Ceil(n).W)))
19	  })
20	  assert(initsel < n.U)
21	  val addrWidth = log2Ceil(n).W
22	
23	  val last = RegInit(UInt(addrWidth), initsel - 1.U(addrWidth))
24	  val in, in_RR = Wire(UInt(n.W))
25	  in := io.in.asUInt
26	
27	  val shift = last + 1.U
28	  in_RR := (in >> shift) | (in << (n.U - shift))   // Circular shift right `shift = last+1`
29	
30	  io.out.valid := in.orR
31	  io.out.bits := Mux(in.orR, PriorityEncoder(in_RR) + shift, DontCare)
32	
33	  when(io.out.fire) {
34	    last := PriorityEncoder(in_RR) + shift        // update priority
35	  }
36	}
37	
38	object RRPriorityEncoder {
39	  def apply(in: Vec[Bool]): DecoupledIO[UInt]= {
40	    val inst = Module(new RRPriorityEncoder(in.size))
41	    inst.io.in := in
42	    inst.io.out
43	  }
44	  def apply(in: Bits): DecoupledIO[UInt]= {
45	    val inst = Module(new RRPriorityEncoder(in.getWidth))
46	    inst.io.in := VecInit(in.asBools)
47	    inst.io.out
48	  }
49	}
50	
51	/**
52	 * Combinational sort circuit for three UInt
53	 * io.out(0) is the biggest, io.out(2) is the smallest
54	 * @param WIDTH width of the input/output UInt
55	 */
56	class sort3(val WIDTH: Int) extends Module {
57	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
58	    val in = Input(Vec(3, UInt(WIDTH.W)))
59	    val out = Output(Vec(3, UInt(WIDTH.W)))
60	  })
61	  val cmp0 = io.in(0) > io.in(1)
62	  val cmp1 = io.in(1) > io.in(2)
63	  val cmp2 = io.in(2) > io.in(0)
64	  val res = Wire(Vec(3, Vec(2, Bool())))
65	  res(0)(0) := cmp0
66	  res(0)(1) := !cmp2
67	  res(1)(0) := cmp1
68	  res(1)(1) := !cmp0
69	  res(2)(0) := cmp2
70	  res(2)(1) := !cmp1
71	  io.out(0) := Mux1H(Seq(
72	    res(0).asUInt.andR -> io.in(0),
73	    res(1).asUInt.andR -> io.in(1),
74	    res(2).asUInt.andR -> io.in(2),
75	    !(res(0)(0) || res(1)(0) || res(2)(0)) -> io.in(0), // in1 == in2 == in3
76	  ))
77	  io.out(1) := Mux1H(Seq(             // NOTE: here we assumes that when in(0)==in(1)==in(2)==data,
78	    res(0).asUInt.xorR -> io.in(0),   //       as a result of which res(i).xorR==true,
79	    res(1).asUInt.xorR -> io.in(1),   //       Mux1H will output `data` instead of something meaningless.
80	    res(2).asUInt.xorR -> io.in(2),   //       If it's not the truth, an extra Mux is needed
81	  ))
82	  io.out(2) := Mux1H(Seq(
83	    !res(0).asUInt.orR -> io.in(0),
84	    !res(1).asUInt.orR -> io.in(1),
85	    !res(2).asUInt.orR -> io.in(2),
86	    !(res(0)(0) || res(1)(0) || res(2)(0)) -> io.in(0),  // in1 == in2 == in3
87	  ))
88	
89	  assert(io.out(0) >= io.out(1) && io.out(1) >= io.out(2))
90	  for(i <- 0 until 3) assert(io.out(i) === io.in(0) || io.out(i) === io.in(1) || io.out(i) === io.in(2) )
91	}

109	/**
110	 * DecoupledIO 1-to-3
111	 * It's assumed that once in.valid=true, it will keep being true until io.fire
112	 */
113	class DecoupledIO_1_to_3[T0 <: Data, T1 <: Data, T2 <: Data](gen0: T0, gen1: T1, gen2: T2, IGNORE: Boolean = false) extends Module {
114	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
115	    val in = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new Bundle{
116	      val data0 = gen0.cloneType
117	      val data1 = gen1.cloneType
118	      val data2 = gen2.cloneType
119	      val ign0 = if(IGNORE) Some(Bool()) else None
120	      val ign1 = if(IGNORE) Some(Bool()) else None
121	      val ign2 = if(IGNORE) Some(Bool()) else None
122	    }))
123	    val out0 = DecoupledIO(gen0.cloneType)
124	    val out1 = DecoupledIO(gen1.cloneType)
125	    val out2 = DecoupledIO(gen2.cloneType)
126	  })
127	  io.out0.bits <> io.in.bits.data0
128	  io.out1.bits <> io.in.bits.data1
129	  io.out2.bits <> io.in.bits.data2
130	
131	  val fire0, fire1, fire2 = RegInit(false.B)
132	  fire0 := Mux(io.in.fire, false.B, fire0 || io.out0.fire || (io.in.bits.ign0.getOrElse(false.B) && io.in.valid))
133	  fire1 := Mux(io.in.fire, false.B, fire1 || io.out1.fire || (io.in.bits.ign1.getOrElse(false.B) && io.in.valid))
134	  fire2 := Mux(io.in.fire, false.B, fire2 || io.out2.fire || (io.in.bits.ign2.getOrElse(false.B) && io.in.valid))
135	  io.in.ready := (fire0 || io.out0.fire || io.in.bits.ign0.getOrElse(false.B)) &&
136	    (fire1 || io.out1.fire || io.in.bits.ign1.getOrElse(false.B)) &&
137	    (fire2 || io.out2.fire || io.in.bits.ign2.getOrElse(false.B))
138	  io.out0.valid := io.in.valid && !fire0 && !io.in.bits.ign0.getOrElse(false.B)
139	  io.out1.valid := io.in.valid && !fire1 && !io.in.bits.ign1.getOrElse(false.B)
140	  io.out2.valid := io.in.valid && !fire2 && !io.in.bits.ign2.getOrElse(false.B)
141	
142	  // It's assumed that once in.valid=true, it will keep being true until io.fire
143	  val in_fire_r = RegNext(io.in.fire, false.B)
144	  val in_valid_r = RegNext(io.in.valid, false.B)
145	  assert(in_fire_r || !(in_valid_r && !io.in.valid))
146	}

148	/** Skid buffer for DecoupledIO.ready
149	 *  io.in.ready is registered
150	 */
151	class skid_ready[T <: Data](gen: T) extends Module {
152	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
153	    val in = Flipped(DecoupledIO(gen))
154	    val out = DecoupledIO(gen)
155	  })
156	
157	  val in_ready = RegInit(true.B)          // Initially, skidReg is empty, so at least 1 data can be received
158	  val dataValid = WireInit(!in_ready)
159	
160	  val skid = io.in.fire && !io.out.ready  // new data received && downstream refuse to get new data <=> skid
161	  val data = RegEnable(io.in.bits, skid)  // skid => skidReg updated
162	
163	  // @posedge(clk) in_ready := true   <=>   (it is newly set to true) || (it keeps its original true value)
164	  // original true kept <=> skidReg keeps clean <=> skidReg was clean && no data is written(!skid)
165	  // new true <=> skidReg cleared <=> skidReg wasn't clean && downstream is ok to accept new data
166	  in_ready := (in_ready && !skid) || (!in_ready && io.out.ready)
167	
168	  io.in.ready := in_ready
169	  io.out.valid := dataValid || io.in.valid
170	  io.out.bits := Mux(dataValid, data, io.in.bits)   // bypass
171	}
172	
173	object skid_ready {
174	  def apply[T <: Data](in: DecoupledIO[T]) : DecoupledIO[T] = {
175	    val inst = Module(new skid_ready(chiselTypeOf(in.bits)))
176	    inst.io.in := in
177	    inst.io.out
178	  }
179	}

181	/** Skid buffer for DecoupledIO.valid and DecoupledIO.bits
182	 */
183	class skid_valid[T <: Data](gen: T) extends Module {
184	  val io = IO(new Bundle() {
185	    val in = Flipped(DecoupledIO(gen))
186	    val out = DecoupledIO(gen)
187	    val in_en = Input(Bool())
188	  })
189	  val data = RegEnable(io.in.bits, io.in.fire)  // Newly received data is stored to dataReg
190	
191	  val dataValid = RegInit(false.B)              // dataReg is empty initially
192	
193	  //when(io.in.valid && io.in_en) { // upstream new data available
194	  //  dataValid := true.B
195	  //} .elsewhen(!io.out.ready) {    // upstream unavailable && downstream unready
196	  //  dataValid := dataValid
197	  //} .otherwise {                  // upstream unavailable && downstream ready
198	  //  dataValid := false.B
199	  //}
200	  dataValid := (io.in.valid && io.in_en) || (!io.out.ready && dataValid) // equivalent logic
201	
202	  io.in.ready := !dataValid || io.out.ready && io.in_en  // dataReg is empty || downstream is ok to take data out of dataReg
203	  io.out.valid := dataValid
204	  io.out.bits := data
205	}

207	object skid_valid {
208	  /** skid buffer for DecoupledIO valid and data
209	   *
210	   * @param in: upstream DecoupledIO interface
211	   * @param in_en: external control logic which allows getting new data from upstream
212	   * @return downstream DecoupledIO interface
213	   */
214	  def apply[T <: Data](in: DecoupledIO[T], in_en: Bool = true.B): DecoupledIO[T] = {
215	    val inst = Module(new skid_valid(chiselTypeOf(in.bits)))
216	    inst.io.in := in
217	    inst.io.in_en := in_en
218	    inst.io.out
219	  }

76	class resource_table_handler(NUM_CU_LOCAL: Int, NUM_RESOURCE: Int, NUM_RT_RESULT: Int = CONFIG.RESOURCE_TABLE.NUM_RESULT) extends Module {
77	  // Constants
78	  val NUM_WG_SLOT = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT
79	  val NUM_CU = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU
80	  // IO
81	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
82	    val dealloc = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new Bundle {          // dealloc request from CU interface
83	      val cu_id_local = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU_LOCAL).W)      // CU ID of WG in this handler-rtram group
84	      val cu_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W)                  // Global CU ID of this WG
85	      val wg_slot_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W)
86	      val wg_id: Option[UInt] = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
87	    }))
88	    val alloc = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new Bundle {            // alloc request from Allocator
89	      val cu_id_local = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU_LOCAL).W)      // CU ID of WG in this handler-rtram group
90	      val cu_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W)                  // Global CU ID of this WG
91	      val wg_slot_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W)
92	      val num_resource = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)
93	      val wg_id: Option[UInt] = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
94	    }))
95	    val baseaddr = DecoupledIO(new Bundle {                 // result of alloc req, resource base address of the allocating WG
96	      val cu_id = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU).W)
97	      val addr = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE).W)             // the found base address
98	      val wg_id: Option[UInt] = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)) else None
99	    })
100	    val rtcache_update = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cache(NUM_RESOURCE))   // update rtcache in Allocator, result of rtram scan
101	    val rtram_sel = DecoupledIO(new Bundle {                // control the Bus-MUX of this handler-rtram group
102	      val sel = UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU_LOCAL).W)              // cu_id_local
103	    })
104	    val rtram_data = new io_rtram(NUM_RESOURCE = NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_WG_SLOT = NUM_WG_SLOT)   // IO to the selected rtram
105	  })
106	
107	  // =
108	  // Main FSM - define
109	  // =
110	  object FSM extends ChiselEnum {
111	    val IDLE, CONNECT_ALLOC, ALLOC, CONNECT_DEALLOC, DEALLOC, SCAN, OUTPUT = Value
112	  }
113	  val fsm_next = Wire(FSM())
114	  val fsm = RegNext(fsm_next, FSM.IDLE)
115	
116	  // sub-fsm finish signals
117	  val alloc_ok = Wire(Bool())
118	  val dealloc_ok = Wire(Bool())
119	  val scan_ok = Wire(Bool())
120	  val output_ok = RegInit(false.B)
121	
122	  // =
123	  // IO output driver: alloc, dealloc, rtram
124	  // =
125	
126	  // rtram select
127	  val cu_sel = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_CU_LOCAL).W))
128	  val cu_sel_en = RegInit(false.B)
129	  io.rtram_sel.valid := cu_sel_en
130	  io.rtram_sel.bits.sel := cu_sel
131	
132	  // alloc/dealloc ready control
133	  // CU resource table handler can only change its target CU in IDLE state
134	  // ready to receive a new alloc request <=> IDLE || ( (req CU == current CU) && (able to preempt) )
135	  // ready to receive a new dealloc request <=> (IDLE && no alloc) || (no_same_cu_alloc && (req CU == current CU) && (able to preempt) )
136	  io.alloc.ready := (fsm === FSM.IDLE) || (cu_sel === io.alloc.bits.cu_id_local && (
137	    (fsm === FSM.ALLOC && alloc_ok) || (fsm === FSM.DEALLOC && dealloc_ok) ||
138	    (fsm === FSM.SCAN) || (fsm === FSM.OUTPUT)
139	  ))
140	
141	  val alloc_same_cu_valid = io.alloc.valid && (cu_sel === io.alloc.bits.cu_id_local) // There is a alloc req which is able to preempt
142	  io.dealloc.ready := (!io.alloc.valid && fsm === FSM.IDLE) || (!alloc_same_cu_valid && cu_sel === io.dealloc.bits.cu_id_local && (
143	    (fsm === FSM.ALLOC && alloc_ok) || (fsm === FSM.DEALLOC && dealloc_ok) ||
144	    (fsm === FSM.SCAN)
145	  ))
146	
147	  // rtram data
148	  // All these three sub-fsm need to read/write io.rtram during their active time, respectively
149	  // The main FSM promises that at most one of these three sub-fsm is active at any moment
150	  // To avoid potential multi-driver problem, each sub-fsm drives their own cluster of rtram signals,
151	  //  and use MUX to triple-select one cluster of signal to drive io.rtram
152	  //                           fsm                        │
153	  //                        ┌───┴───┐                     │
154	  //    fsm_alloc    ─────→ ┤       │                     │    fsm_alloc    ←──────┐
155	  //                        │       │         (output)    │                        │         (input)
156	  //    fsm_dealloc  ─────→ ┤  MUX  ├ ──────→ io.rtram    │    fsm_dealloc  ←──────┼─────── io.rtram
157	  //                        │       │                     │                        │
158	  //    fsm_scan     ─────→ ┤       │                     │    fsm_scan     ←──────┘
159	  //                        └───────┘                     │
160	  // TODO: in chisel3.6, we can use something like this
161	  //  io.rtram_data :<= MuxLookup(fsm, DontCare, Seq(
162	  //    FSM.ALLOC -> rtram_alloc,
163	  //    FSM.DEALLOC -> rtram_dealloc,
164	  //    FSM.SCAN -> rtram_scan,
165	  //  ))
166	  //  io.rtram_data :>= rtram_alloc
167	  //  io.rtram_data :>= rtram_dealloc
168	  //  io.rtram_data :>= rtram_scan
169	  val rtram_alloc   = WireInit(new io_rtram(NUM_RESOURCE = NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_WG_SLOT = NUM_WG_SLOT), DontCare)
170	  val rtram_dealloc = WireInit(new io_rtram(NUM_RESOURCE = NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_WG_SLOT = NUM_WG_SLOT), DontCare)
171	  val rtram_scan    = WireInit(new io_rtram(NUM_RESOURCE = NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_WG_SLOT = NUM_WG_SLOT), DontCare)
172	  when(fsm === FSM.SCAN) {
173	    io.rtram_data <> rtram_scan
174	  } .elsewhen(fsm === FSM.DEALLOC) {
175	    io.rtram_data <> rtram_dealloc
176	  } .otherwise {
177	    io.rtram_data <> rtram_alloc
178	  }
179	
180	  // =
181	  // Main FSM - actions
182	  // =
183	
184	  // Action 1: get WG info when a new alloc/dealloc request is received
185	  val wgsize = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W))
186	  val wgslot = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
187	  val wg_cu = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU).W))
188	  assert(!(io.alloc.fire && io.dealloc.fire)) // only one request can be received in a same cycle
189	
190	  wgsize := Mux(io.alloc.fire, io.alloc.bits.num_resource, wgsize)
191	  wgslot := Mux1H(Seq(
192	    io.alloc.fire -> io.alloc.bits.wg_slot_id,
193	    io.dealloc.fire -> io.dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id,
194	    (!io.alloc.fire && !io.dealloc.fire) -> wgslot,
195	  ))
196	  wg_cu := Mux1H(Seq(
197	    io.alloc.fire -> io.alloc.bits.cu_id,
198	    io.dealloc.fire -> io.dealloc.bits.cu_id,
199	    (!io.alloc.fire && !io.dealloc.fire) -> wg_cu,
200	  ))
201	
202	  val wg_id = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(Reg(UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH))) else None
203	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG){
204	    wg_id.get := Mux1H(Seq(
205	      io.alloc.fire -> io.alloc.bits.wg_id.get,
206	      io.dealloc.fire -> io.dealloc.bits.wg_id.get,
207	      (!io.alloc.fire && !io.dealloc.fire) -> wg_id.get,
208	    ))
209	  }
210	
211	  // Action 2: get new target CU when a different CU's request is received in IDLE state
212	  // But there is no need to check whether fsm===IDLE,
213	  //  since if (fsm=/=IDLE) && (req.fire), there must be (cu_sel===new_cu_id), new assignment has no effect (see the next assert)
214	  cu_sel := Mux1H(Seq(
215	    io.alloc.fire -> io.alloc.bits.cu_id_local,
216	    io.dealloc.fire -> io.dealloc.bits.cu_id_local,
217	    (!io.alloc.fire && !io.dealloc.fire) -> cu_sel,
218	  ))
219	  // In non-IDLE state, only request of the same CU will be received
220	  when(fsm =/= FSM.IDLE) {
221	    when(io.alloc.fire){
222	      assert(cu_sel === io.alloc.bits.cu_id_local)
223	    }
224	    when(io.dealloc.fire){
225	      assert(cu_sel === io.dealloc.bits.cu_id_local)
226	    }
227	  }
228	  // In this implement, no need to disconnect
229	  cu_sel_en := cu_sel_en || io.alloc.fire || io.dealloc.fire
230	
231	  // =
232	  // Sub FSM ALLOC (Main FSM action 3)
233	  // =
234	
235	  object FSM_A extends ChiselEnum {
236	    val IDLE, FIND, WRITE_OUTPUT = Value
237	  }
238	  val fsm_a_next = Wire(FSM_A())
239	  val fsm_a = RegNext(fsm_a_next, FSM_A.IDLE)
240	
241	  // Sub-FSM ALLOC action 1:
242	  // Iterate over the linked-list, and find a proper base address for the new alloc request
243	  // Number of WG in the linked-list: rtram.cnt
244	  // Number of idle resource segment which need to be checked: rtram.cnt + 1, so 0 ≤ fsm_a_cnt ≤ rtram.cnt
245	  val fsm_a_cnt = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT+2).W))     // number of idle resource segment which has already been checked
246	  val fsm_a_found_ok = WireInit(Bool(), DontCare)             // final result will be given out next cycle, so it's ready to jump to the next state
247	  val fsm_a_found_size = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W))// size of the currently selected resource segment
248	  val fsm_a_found_addr = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE).W))  // base address of the currently selected resource segment
249	  val fsm_a_found_ptr1 = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))   // pointer to the WG which locates before the currently selected resource segment
250	  val fsm_a_found_ptr2 = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))   // pointer to the WG which locates after  the currently selected resource segment
251	  val fsm_a_ptr1 = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))         // pointer to the WG which locates before the currently checked resource segment
252	  val fsm_a_ptr2 = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))        // pointer to the WG which locates after  the currently checked resource segment
253	  val fsm_a_head_flag, fsm_a_tail_flag = Reg(Bool())          // if the currently selected segment will be the new head/tail node of the linked-list
254	  val fsm_a_valid_p1 = RegInit(false.B)                       // valid  signal of pipeline stage 1
255	  val fsm_a_init_p1 = RegInit(false.B)                        // init   signal of pipeline stage 1
256	  val fsm_a_finish_p1 = RegInit(false.B)                      // finish signal of pipeline stage 1
257	  // if you want to send control/data signal to io.rtram, use rtram_alloc
258	  // if you want to get signal value from io.rtram, use rtram_alloc(recommended) or io.rtram, both ok
259	  fsm_a_ptr2 := DontCare  // switch default
260	  switch(fsm_a) {
261	    is(FSM_A.IDLE) {  // prepare for FSM_A.FIND
262	      // Even before the iteration begins, we have already know that we can successfully find a resource segment which is large enough
263	      // What we want to find is the smallest segment that can contain the WG (large but not too large)
264	      // At the beginning, assume we will find the largest segment (the whole resource, NUM_RESOURCE)
265	      //  then, step by step we will find smaller segments
266	      // In the first iteration step, we will check the resource segment before the first WG, even if it may not exist
267	      // In the last iteration step, we will check the resource segment after the last WG, even if it may not exist
268	      fsm_a_cnt := 0.U                    // Iteration range: 0 to rtram.cnt
269	      fsm_a_found_size := NUM_RESOURCE.U  // Initial assumption: assume we select the whole resource.
270	      fsm_a_found_addr := 0.U             // ⬑ This will be changed to the right segment later, unless rtram.cnt==0 and the initial assumption is correct
271	      fsm_a_found_ptr1 := DontCare        // In our initial assumption, the linked-list is empty, so we don't care this pointer
272	      fsm_a_found_ptr2 := DontCare
273	      fsm_a_ptr1 := DontCare              // Before the first resource segment locates nothing
274	      fsm_a_ptr2 := DontCare              // After the first resource segment locates the first WG
275	      fsm_a_head_flag := true.B
276	      fsm_a_tail_flag := true.B           // In our initial assumption, the linked-list is empty, so the new WG will become head as well as tail
277	      fsm_a_valid_p1 := false.B
278	      fsm_a_init_p1 := false.B
279	      fsm_a_finish_p1 := false.B
280	    }
281	    is(FSM_A.FIND) {
282	      // Since rtram.next,addr1,addr2 use SyncReadMem, we need at least 2 cycles to deal with 1 resource segment
283	      //  cycle 1: update prt1 & ptr2
284	      //  cycle 2: get WG addr2 & addr1 from rtram
285	      //  cycle 3: calculate the size of this resource segment, compare size, give out the new result (registered)
286	      // We can build a pipeline: update ptr -> fetch data (addr1 & addr2) from rtram -> calc result
287	
288	      // pipeline stage 0: WG pointers
289	      fsm_a_ptr1 := fsm_a_ptr2
290	      rtram_alloc.next(fsm_a_ptr2)  // rtram.next.rd.data is a register of pipeline stage 0
291	      // pipeline stage 2: fetch data from rtram (addr1 & addr2)
292	      fsm_a_ptr2 := Mux(fsm_a_cnt === 0.U, rtram_alloc.head(), rtram_alloc.next.rd.data)
293	      rtram_alloc.addr2(fsm_a_ptr1) // rtram.addr2.rd.data is a register of pipeline stage 1
294	      rtram_alloc.addr1(fsm_a_ptr2) // rtram.addr1.rd.data is a register of pipeline stage 1
295	      fsm_a_init_p1 := (fsm_a_cnt === 0.U)
296	      fsm_a_finish_p1 := (fsm_a_cnt === rtram_alloc.cnt())
297	      fsm_a_valid_p1 := (fsm_a_valid_p1 && !fsm_a_finish_p1) || (fsm_a_cnt === 0.U)
298	      val fsm_a_ptr1_p1 = RegNext(fsm_a_ptr1)
299	      val fsm_a_ptr2_p1 = RegNext(fsm_a_ptr2)
300	      // pipeline stage 3: resource segment size calc & found result update
301	      val addr1, addr2 = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)) // addr1 = this resource segment's start addr - 1, addr2 = resource segment's end addr
302	      addr1 := Mux(fsm_a_init_p1, (~0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)).asUInt, rtram_alloc.addr2.rd.data)
303	      addr2 := Mux(fsm_a_finish_p1, (NUM_RESOURCE-1).U, rtram_alloc.addr1.rd.data.pad(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1)) - 1.U)
304	      val size = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W), addr2 - addr1) // resource segment size
305	      val result_update = (size >= wgsize) && (size < fsm_a_found_size)
306	      fsm_a_found_size := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, size, fsm_a_found_size)
307	      fsm_a_found_addr := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, addr1 + 1.U, fsm_a_found_addr)
308	      fsm_a_found_ptr1 := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, fsm_a_ptr1_p1, fsm_a_found_ptr1)
309	      fsm_a_found_ptr2 := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, fsm_a_ptr2_p1, fsm_a_found_ptr2)
310	      fsm_a_tail_flag := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, fsm_a_finish_p1, fsm_a_tail_flag)
311	      fsm_a_head_flag := Mux(fsm_a_valid_p1 && result_update, fsm_a_init_p1, fsm_a_head_flag)
312	      // Iteration step
313	      fsm_a_cnt := fsm_a_cnt + 1.U
314	      // pipeline will give out the final result in the next cycle, so it's ready to jump to the next state
315	      fsm_a_found_ok := fsm_a_init_p1
316	      if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
317	        val fsm_a_found = RegInit(false.B)
318	        fsm_a_found := MuxCase(fsm_a_found, Seq(
319	          fsm_a_init_p1 -> result_update,
320	          fsm_a_valid_p1 -> (fsm_a_found || result_update),
321	        ))
322	        // After ALLOC scan finishes, a new baseaddr should already be found, unless there are no WG in the linked-list
323	        assert(!fsm_a_finish_p1 || (fsm_a_found || result_update) || (rtram_alloc.cnt() === 0.U))
324	      }
325	    }
326	    is(FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) {  // keep useful data for FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT, and prepare for FSM_A.FIND
327	      // Useless for WRITE & OUTPUT, initialize them for next FSM_A.FIND
328	      fsm_a_cnt := 0.U
329	      fsm_a_ptr1 := DontCare
330	      fsm_a_ptr2 := DontCare
331	      fsm_a_valid_p1 := false.B
332	      fsm_a_init_p1 := false.B
333	      fsm_a_finish_p1 := false.B
334	      fsm_a_found_size := NUM_RESOURCE.U
335	      // Useful for WRITE & OUTPUT, keep their value unchanged until finishing
336	      fsm_a_found_addr := Mux(fsm_a_next =/= fsm_a, 0.U, fsm_a_found_addr)
337	      fsm_a_found_ptr1 := Mux(fsm_a_next =/= fsm_a, DontCare, fsm_a_found_ptr1)
338	      fsm_a_found_ptr2 := Mux(fsm_a_next =/= fsm_a, DontCare, fsm_a_found_ptr2)
339	      fsm_a_head_flag := Mux(fsm_a_next =/= fsm_a, true.B, fsm_a_head_flag)
340	      fsm_a_tail_flag := Mux(fsm_a_next =/= fsm_a, true.B, fsm_a_tail_flag)
341	    }
342	  }
343	
344	  // Sub-FSM ALLOC action 2 (FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT):
345	  // Write the new WG to the location just found in FSM_A.FIND
346	  val fsm_a_write_cnt = Reg(UInt(2.W))  // you can also reuse fsm_a_cnt
347	  fsm_a_write_cnt := MuxCase(fsm_a_write_cnt, Seq(
348	    (fsm_a =/= FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) -> 0.U,
349	    (fsm_a_write_cnt <= 1.U) -> (fsm_a_write_cnt + 1.U),
350	  ))
351	  // if wgsize==0, this WG will not be inserted to the linked-list
352	  rtram_alloc.head.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && fsm_a_head_flag && !(wgsize === 0.U)
353	  rtram_alloc.head.wr.data := wgslot
354	  rtram_alloc.tail.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && fsm_a_tail_flag && !(wgsize === 0.U)
355	  rtram_alloc.tail.wr.data := wgslot
356	  rtram_alloc.cnt.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
357	  rtram_alloc.cnt.wr.data := rtram_alloc.cnt() + 1.U
358	  rtram_alloc.prev.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && ((fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U && !fsm_a_tail_flag) || fsm_a_write_cnt === 1.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
359	  rtram_alloc.prev.wr.addr := Mux(fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U, fsm_a_found_ptr2, wgslot)
360	  rtram_alloc.prev.wr.data := Mux(fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U, wgslot, fsm_a_found_ptr1)
361	  rtram_alloc.next.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && ((fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U && !fsm_a_head_flag) || fsm_a_write_cnt === 1.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
362	  rtram_alloc.next.wr.addr := Mux(fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U, fsm_a_found_ptr1, wgslot)
363	  rtram_alloc.next.wr.data := Mux(fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U, wgslot, fsm_a_found_ptr2)
364	  rtram_alloc.addr1.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
365	  rtram_alloc.addr1.wr.addr := wgslot
366	  rtram_alloc.addr1.wr.data := fsm_a_found_addr
367	  rtram_alloc.addr2.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
368	  rtram_alloc.addr2.wr.addr := wgslot
369	  rtram_alloc.addr2.wr.data := fsm_a_found_addr + wgsize - 1.U
370	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
371	    rtram_alloc.valid.get.rd.addr := wgslot
372	    when(fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT && fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) {
373	      assert(rtram_alloc.valid.get.rd.data === false.B)
374	    }
375	    rtram_alloc.wgid.get.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
376	    rtram_alloc.wgid.get.wr.addr := wgslot
377	    rtram_alloc.wgid.get.wr.data := wg_id.get
378	    rtram_alloc.valid.get.wr.en := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && (fsm_a_write_cnt === 0.U) && !(wgsize === 0.U)
379	    rtram_alloc.valid.get.wr.addr := wgslot
380	    rtram_alloc.valid.get.wr.data := true.B
381	  }
382	  val fsm_a_write_ok = (fsm_a_write_cnt >= 1.U)
383	
384	  // if the new WG becomes the head node of the linked-list, base address must be 0
385	  assert((fsm_a =/= FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) || fsm_a_head_flag === (fsm_a_found_addr === 0.U))
386	
387	  // Sub-FSM ALLOC action 3 (FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT):
388	  // Output the found base address to CU Interface (may be there is a FIFO in resource_table_top)
389	  val fsm_a_output_valid = RegInit(true.B)
390	  fsm_a_output_valid := Mux(fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT, fsm_a_output_valid && !io.baseaddr.fire, true.B)
391	  io.baseaddr.valid := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && fsm_a_output_valid
392	  io.baseaddr.bits.cu_id := wg_cu
393	  io.baseaddr.bits.addr := fsm_a_found_addr
394	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {io.baseaddr.bits.wg_id.get := wg_id.get}
395	  val fsm_a_output_ok = !fsm_a_output_valid || io.baseaddr.fire
396	
397	  // Sub-FSM ALLOC state transition logic
398	  fsm_a_next := MuxLookup(fsm_a.asUInt, FSM_A.IDLE)(Seq(
399	    FSM_A.IDLE.asUInt -> Mux(fsm_next === FSM.ALLOC && fsm_next =/= fsm, FSM_A.FIND, fsm_a),
400	    FSM_A.FIND.asUInt -> Mux(wgsize === 0.U || fsm_a_cnt > io.rtram_data.cnt(), FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT, fsm_a),   // if wgsize==0, no need to scan the linked-list
401	    FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT.asUInt -> MuxCase(FSM_A.IDLE, Seq(
402	      !alloc_ok -> fsm_a,
403	      io.alloc.fire -> FSM_A.FIND,
404	    ))
405	  ))
406	
407	  alloc_ok := (fsm_a === FSM_A.WRITE_OUTPUT) && fsm_a_write_ok && fsm_a_output_ok
408	
409	  // =
410	  // FSM.DEALLOC action (Main FSM action 4)
411	  // =
412	  val fsm_d = RegInit(0.U(2.W))
413	  fsm_d := Mux(fsm =/= FSM.DEALLOC || io.dealloc.fire, 0.U, Mux(!fsm_d.andR, fsm_d + 1.U, fsm_d))
414	  val fsm_d_prev, fsm_d_next = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
415	  fsm_d_prev := rtram_dealloc.prev(wgslot)
416	  fsm_d_next := rtram_dealloc.next(wgslot)
417	  rtram_dealloc.next.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U) && (wgslot =/= rtram_dealloc.head())
418	  rtram_dealloc.next.wr.addr := fsm_d_prev
419	  rtram_dealloc.next.wr.data := fsm_d_next
420	  rtram_dealloc.prev.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U) && (wgslot =/= rtram_dealloc.tail())
421	  rtram_dealloc.prev.wr.addr := fsm_d_next
422	  rtram_dealloc.prev.wr.data := fsm_d_prev
423	  rtram_dealloc.cnt.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U)
424	  rtram_dealloc.cnt.wr.data := rtram_dealloc.cnt() - 1.U
425	  rtram_dealloc.head.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U) && (wgslot === rtram_dealloc.head())
426	  rtram_dealloc.head.wr.data := fsm_d_next
427	  rtram_dealloc.tail.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U) && (wgslot === rtram_dealloc.tail())
428	  rtram_dealloc.tail.wr.data := fsm_d_prev
429	  rtram_dealloc.addr2.wr.en := false.B
430	  rtram_dealloc.addr2.wr.en := false.B
431	
432	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
433	    rtram_dealloc.wgid.get.rd.addr := wgslot
434	    rtram_dealloc.valid.get.rd.addr := wgslot
435	    when(fsm === FSM.DEALLOC) {
436	      assert(rtram_dealloc.wgid.get.rd.data === wg_id.get)
437	      assert(rtram_dealloc.valid.get.rd.data)
438	    }
439	    rtram_dealloc.valid.get.wr.en := (fsm_d === 1.U)
440	    rtram_dealloc.valid.get.wr.addr := wgslot
441	    rtram_dealloc.valid.get.wr.data := false.B
442	  }
443	
444	  dealloc_ok := (fsm === FSM.DEALLOC) && (fsm_d >= 1.U)
445	
446	  // =
447	  // Sub-FSM SCAN (Main FSM action 5)
448	  // =
449	  val fsm_s_ptr1 = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))   // pointer to the WG which locate before the currently checked resource segments
450	  val fsm_s_ptr2 = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))  // pointer to the WG which locate after  the currently checked resource segments
451	  val fsm_s_init_p1 = RegInit(false.B)
452	  val fsm_s_finish_p1 = RegInit(false.B)
453	  val fsm_s_valid_p1 = RegInit(false.B)
454	  val fsm_s_cnt = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT+2).W))   // you can also reuse fsm_a_cnt
455	  fsm_s_cnt := Mux(fsm =/= FSM.SCAN || fsm_next =/= FSM.SCAN, 0.U, fsm_s_cnt + 1.U)
456	  val rtcache_data = RegInit(VecInit.fill(NUM_RT_RESULT)(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)))  // scan result, rtcache_data[0] is the largest resource segment
457	  when(fsm === FSM.SCAN){
458	    // pipeline stage 0: pointer step
459	    fsm_s_ptr1 := fsm_s_ptr2
460	    rtram_scan.next(fsm_s_ptr2)       // rtram_scan.next.rd.data is a pipeline stage 0 register
461	    // pipeline stage 1: rtram data fetch - addr1 & addr2
462	    fsm_s_ptr2 := Mux(fsm_s_cnt === 0.U, rtram_scan.head(), rtram_scan.next.rd.data)
463	    rtram_scan.addr2(fsm_s_ptr1)      // rtram_scan.addr2.rd.data is a pipeline stage 1 register
464	    rtram_scan.addr1(fsm_s_ptr2)      // rtram_scan.addr1.rd.data is a pipeline stage 1 register
465	    fsm_s_init_p1 := (fsm_s_cnt === 0.U)
466	    fsm_s_finish_p1 := (fsm_s_cnt === rtram_scan.cnt())
467	    fsm_s_valid_p1 := (fsm_s_valid_p1 && !fsm_s_finish_p1) || (fsm_s_cnt === 0.U)
468	    // pipeline stage 2: resource segment size calc & sort
469	    val addr1 = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W), Mux(fsm_s_init_p1, (~0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)).asUInt, rtram_scan.addr2.rd.data.pad(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1))))
470	    val addr2 = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W), Mux(fsm_s_finish_p1, NUM_RESOURCE.U - 1.U, rtram_scan.addr1.rd.data.pad(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1)) - 1.U))
471	    val thissize = WireInit(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W), addr2 - addr1)
472	    val result = Wire(Vec(NUM_RT_RESULT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE+1).W)))
473	    if(NUM_RT_RESULT == 1) {
474	      val rtcache_data_tmp = Mux(fsm_s_init_p1, 0.U, rtcache_data(0))
475	      result := VecInit(Mux(rtcache_data_tmp > thissize, rtcache_data_tmp, thissize))
476	    } else if (NUM_RT_RESULT == 2) {
477	      // This implement only support NUM_RT_RESULT=2. Replace `sort3()` to support other values
478	      val result_tmp = sort3(Mux(fsm_s_init_p1, 0.U, rtcache_data(0)), Mux(fsm_s_init_p1, 0.U, rtcache_data(1)), thissize)
479	      result(0) := result_tmp(0)
480	      result(1) := result_tmp(1)
481	    } else assert(NUM_RT_RESULT == 1 || NUM_RT_RESULT == 2)
482	    for(i <- 0 until NUM_RT_RESULT) {
483	      rtcache_data(i) := result(i)
484	    }
485	    // pipeline debug
486	    if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
487	      rtram_scan.valid.get.rd.addr := fsm_s_ptr1
488	      rtram_scan.wgid.get.rd.addr := fsm_s_ptr1
489	      val checked_wg_valid = RegInit(0.U(NUM_WG_SLOT.W))
490	      val checked_wg = ShiftRegisters(rtram_scan.wgid.get.rd.data, NUM_WG_SLOT)
491	      checked_wg_valid := Mux(fsm_s_init_p1, 1.U, (checked_wg_valid << 1).asUInt | (fsm_s_valid_p1 && !fsm_s_finish_p1).asUInt)
492	      when(fsm_s_finish_p1) {
493	        for(i <- 0 until NUM_WG_SLOT) {
494	          when(checked_wg_valid(i)) {
495	            for(j <- 0 until NUM_WG_SLOT) {
496	              // A same linked-list node should only be visited once
497	              assert(!checked_wg_valid(j) || (i == j).asBool || checked_wg(i) =/= checked_wg(j))
498	            }
499	          }
500	        }
501	      }
502	      when(fsm_s_valid_p1) {
503	        assert(fsm_s_finish_p1 || rtram_scan.valid.get.rd.data) // The linked-list node we are visiting should stores valid data
504	        for(i <- 0 until NUM_RT_RESULT) {
505	          assert(fsm_s_init_p1 || rtcache_data(i) <= result(i))
506	        }
507	      }
508	    }
509	  } .otherwise { // prepare for FSM.SCAN
510	    fsm_s_ptr1 := DontCare
511	    fsm_s_ptr2 := DontCare
512	    fsm_s_init_p1 := false.B
513	    fsm_s_finish_p1 := false.B
514	    fsm_s_valid_p1 := false.B
515	    // keep rtcache_data untouched
516	  }
517	  scan_ok := (fsm === FSM.SCAN) && fsm_s_finish_p1
518	
519	  // =
520	  // Sub-FSM OUTPUT (Main FSM action 6)
521	  // =
522	  output_ok := Mux(fsm === FSM.OUTPUT, output_ok || io.rtcache_update.fire, false.B)
523	  io.rtcache_update.valid := (fsm === FSM.OUTPUT) && !output_ok
524	  io.rtcache_update.bits.cu_id := wg_cu
525	  io.rtcache_update.bits.size := rtcache_data
526	
527	  // =
528	  // Main FSM - state transition logic
529	  // =
530	
531	  fsm_next := FSM.IDLE    // switch default
532	  switch(fsm) {
533	    is(FSM.IDLE) {
534	      fsm_next := MuxCase(fsm, Seq(
535	        io.alloc.fire -> Mux(cu_sel === io.alloc.bits.cu_id_local && io.rtram_sel.fire, FSM.ALLOC, FSM.CONNECT_ALLOC),
536	        io.dealloc.fire -> Mux(cu_sel === io.dealloc.bits.cu_id_local && io.rtram_sel.fire, FSM.DEALLOC, FSM.CONNECT_DEALLOC),
537	      ))
538	    }
539	    is(FSM.CONNECT_ALLOC, FSM.CONNECT_DEALLOC) {
540	      fsm_next := MuxCase(fsm, Seq(
541	        io.rtram_sel.fire -> Mux(fsm === FSM.CONNECT_ALLOC, FSM.ALLOC, FSM.DEALLOC),
542	      ))
543	    }
544	    is(FSM.ALLOC) {
545	      fsm_next := MuxCase(FSM.SCAN, Seq(
546	        !alloc_ok -> fsm,
547	        io.alloc.fire -> FSM.ALLOC,
548	        io.dealloc.fire -> FSM.DEALLOC,
549	      ))
550	    }
551	    is(FSM.DEALLOC) {
552	      fsm_next := MuxCase(FSM.SCAN, Seq(
553	        !dealloc_ok -> fsm,
554	        io.alloc.fire -> FSM.ALLOC,
555	        io.dealloc.fire -> FSM.DEALLOC,
556	      ))
557	    }
558	    is(FSM.SCAN) {
559	      fsm_next := MuxCase(fsm, Seq(
560	        io.alloc.fire -> FSM.ALLOC,
561	        io.dealloc.fire -> FSM.DEALLOC,
562	        scan_ok -> FSM.OUTPUT
563	      ))
564	    }
565	    is(FSM.OUTPUT) {
566	      fsm_next := MuxCase(fsm, Seq(
567	        io.alloc.fire -> FSM.ALLOC,
568	        output_ok -> FSM.IDLE,
569	      ))
570	    }
571	  }
572	}

574	class resource_table_ram(NUM_RESOURCE: Int, NUM_WG_SLOT: Int = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT) extends Module {
575	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
576	    val en = Input(Bool())  // if en==false.B, write operation is prohibited
577	    val data = Flipped(new io_rtram(NUM_RESOURCE, NUM_WG_SLOT))
578	  })
579	
580	  val cnt = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT+1).W))
581	  val head = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
582	  val tail = Reg(UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
583	  val prev = SyncReadMem(NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
584	  val next = SyncReadMem(NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_WG_SLOT).W))
585	  val addr1 = SyncReadMem(NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE).W))
586	  val addr2 = SyncReadMem(NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(log2Ceil(NUM_RESOURCE).W))
587	
588	  io.data.cnt.rd.data := cnt
589	  when(io.en && io.data.cnt.wr.en) {cnt := io.data.cnt.wr.data}
590	  io.data.head.rd.data := head
591	  when(io.en && io.data.head.wr.en) {head := io.data.head.wr.data}
592	  io.data.tail.rd.data := tail
593	  when(io.en && io.data.tail.wr.en) {tail := io.data.tail.wr.data}
594	
595	  io.data.prev.rd.data := prev.read(io.data.prev.rd.addr, io.data.prev.rd.en)
596	  when(io.en && io.data.prev.wr.en) {prev.write(io.data.prev.wr.addr, io.data.prev.wr.data)}
597	  io.data.next.rd.data := next.read(io.data.next.rd.addr, io.data.next.rd.en)
598	  when(io.en && io.data.next.wr.en) {next.write(io.data.next.wr.addr, io.data.next.wr.data)}
599	  io.data.addr1.rd.data := addr1.read(io.data.addr1.rd.addr, io.data.addr1.rd.en)
600	  when(io.en && io.data.addr1.wr.en) {addr1.write(io.data.addr1.wr.addr, io.data.addr1.wr.data)}
601	  io.data.addr2.rd.data := addr2.read(io.data.addr2.rd.addr, io.data.addr2.rd.en)
602	  when(io.en && io.data.addr2.wr.en) {addr2.write(io.data.addr2.wr.addr, io.data.addr2.wr.data)}
603	
604	  // For debug
605	  val wgid = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(Reg(Vec(NUM_WG_SLOT, UInt(CONFIG.WG.WG_ID_WIDTH)))) else None
606	  val valid = if(CONFIG.DEBUG) Some(RegInit(VecInit.fill(NUM_WG_SLOT)(false.B))) else None
607	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
608	    when(io.en && io.data.wgid.get.wr.en) {(wgid.get)(io.data.wgid.get.wr.addr) := io.data.wgid.get.wr.data}
609	    io.data.wgid.get.rd.data := (wgid.get)(io.data.wgid.get.rd.addr)
610	    when(io.en && io.data.valid.get.wr.en) {(valid.get)(io.data.valid.get.wr.addr) := io.data.valid.get.wr.data}
611	    io.data.valid.get.rd.data := (valid.get)(io.data.valid.get.rd.addr)
612	
613	    assert(PopCount(valid.get) === cnt)
614	  }
615	}
