617	/**
618	 * It is assumed that once alloc/dealloc.valid = true, it will keep valid until alloc/dealloc.fire
619	 */
620	class resource_table_top(val NUM_CU_PER_GROUP: Int = 1) extends Module {
621	  // Constants used in IO
622	  val NUM_LDS = CONFIG.WG.NUM_LDS_MAX
623	  val NUM_SGPR = CONFIG.WG.NUM_SGPR_MAX
624	  val NUM_VGPR = CONFIG.WG.NUM_VGPR_MAX
625	  // IO
626	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
627	    val alloc = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_alloc2rt))           // alloc   request from Allocator
628	    val dealloc = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new io_cuinterface2rt))   // dealloc request from CU interface
629	    val slot_dealloc = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2dealloc)           // dealloc request of WG/WF slot to Allocator
630	    val rtcache_lds  = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cache(NUM_LDS ))   // rtcache update request to Allocator
631	    val rtcache_sgpr = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cache(NUM_SGPR))
632	    val rtcache_vgpr = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cache(NUM_VGPR))
633	    val cuinterface_wg_new = DecoupledIO(new io_rt2cuinterface) // The just-allocated WG info (resource baseaddr) to CU interface
634	  })
635	  // Constants
636	  val NUM_CU = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_CU
637	  val NUM_HANDLER_PER_GROUP = 1
638	  val NUM_HANDLER = NUM_CU / NUM_CU_PER_GROUP * NUM_HANDLER_PER_GROUP
639	  assert(NUM_CU >= NUM_CU_PER_GROUP && NUM_CU % NUM_CU_PER_GROUP == 0)
640	  assert(NUM_HANDLER_PER_GROUP == 1)  // This implement (direct mapping from handler to rtram) only supports NUM_HANDLER_PER_CU=1
641	  val NUM_WG_SLOT = CONFIG.GPU.NUM_WG_SLOT
642	  val NUM_RT_RESULT = CONFIG.RESOURCE_TABLE.NUM_RESULT
643	
644	  // Auxiliary function
645	  // Convert alloc/dealloc request CU ID to RT_handler group ID and local CU ID
646	  def convert_cu_id(cu_id_global: UInt): (UInt, UInt) = {
647	    val cu_id_reversed = Reverse(cu_id_global)
648	    val cu_id_local = if(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP > 1) cu_id_reversed(log2Ceil(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)-1, 0) else WireInit(UInt(0.W), 0.U)
649	    val cu_id_group = if(NUM_CU > NUM_CU_PER_GROUP) cu_id_reversed(log2Ceil(NUM_CU)-1, log2Ceil(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)) else WireInit(UInt(0.W), 0.U)
650	    (cu_id_group, cu_id_local)
651	  }
652	
653	  // =
654	  // Hardware: resource table Handler and its resource table ram
655	  // =
656	
657	  // hardware instantiate
658	  // We cannot index Seq[hardware] dynamically
659	  // If that is needed, we have to export hardware IO as Wire(Vec[IO])
660	  val handler_lds  = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER)(Module(new resource_table_handler(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP, NUM_LDS, NUM_RT_RESULT)))
661	  val handler_sgpr = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER)(Module(new resource_table_handler(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP, NUM_SGPR, NUM_RT_RESULT)))
662	  val handler_vgpr = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER)(Module(new resource_table_handler(NUM_CU_PER_GROUP, NUM_VGPR, NUM_RT_RESULT)))
663	  val rtram_lds  = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)(Module(new resource_table_ram(NUM_LDS , NUM_WG_SLOT)))
664	  val rtram_sgpr = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)(Module(new resource_table_ram(NUM_SGPR, NUM_WG_SLOT)))
665	  val rtram_vgpr = Seq.fill(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)(Module(new resource_table_ram(NUM_VGPR, NUM_WG_SLOT)))
666	  // export IO signals of Seq[hardware] as Wire(Vec[IO])
667	  // these Wires are automatically connected to hardware.io, for example: handler_lds_io(0) <> handler_lds(0).io
668	  val handler_lds_io  = VecInit(handler_lds.map(_.io))
669	  val handler_sgpr_io = VecInit(handler_sgpr.map(_.io))
670	  val handler_vgpr_io = VecInit(handler_vgpr.map(_.io))
671	  val rtram_lds_io  = VecInit.tabulate(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)((x, y) => rtram_lds(x)(y).io.data)
672	  val rtram_sgpr_io = VecInit.tabulate(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)((x, y) => rtram_sgpr(x)(y).io.data)
673	  val rtram_vgpr_io = VecInit.tabulate(NUM_HANDLER, NUM_CU_PER_GROUP)((x, y) => rtram_vgpr(x)(y).io.data)
674	
675	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER; j <- 0 until NUM_CU_PER_GROUP) {
676	    // handler_lds_io(i).rtram_data, rtram_lds_io(i)(j) are both internal wires, we cannot use `<>` to connect them
677	    // In this implement, there are only 1 handler in a group, dynamic MUX of handler.rtram_data is not necessary
678	    // As a result of these two points, we use handler(i).rtram_data instead of handler_io(i).rtram_data
679	    handler_lds_io(i).rtram_data := DontCare
680	    handler_sgpr_io(i).rtram_data := DontCare
681	    handler_vgpr_io(i).rtram_data := DontCare
682	  }
683	
684	  // Dynamic Mux within a group, between handler and rtram
685	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
686	    for(j <- 0 until NUM_CU_PER_GROUP) {
687	      rtram_lds(i)(j).io.en := (handler_lds(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel === j.U)
688	      handler_lds(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_lds_io(i)(j)
689	    }
690	    handler_lds(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_lds_io(i)(handler_lds(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel)
691	    handler_lds_io(i).rtram_sel.ready := true.B
692	    // in this implement, we use MUX to connect handler and the target rtram. Pure combinational logic is always ready
693	  }
694	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
695	    for(j <- 0 until NUM_CU_PER_GROUP) {
696	      rtram_sgpr(i)(j).io.en := (handler_sgpr(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel === j.U)
697	      handler_sgpr(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_sgpr_io(i)(j)
698	    }
699	    handler_sgpr(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_sgpr_io(i)(handler_sgpr(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel)
700	    handler_sgpr_io(i).rtram_sel.ready := true.B
701	  }
702	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
703	    for(j <- 0 until NUM_CU_PER_GROUP) {
704	      rtram_vgpr(i)(j).io.en := (handler_vgpr(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel === j.U)
705	      handler_vgpr(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_vgpr_io(i)(j)
706	    }
707	    handler_vgpr(i).io.rtram_data <> rtram_vgpr_io(i)(handler_vgpr(i).io.rtram_sel.bits.sel)
708	    handler_vgpr_io(i).rtram_sel.ready := true.B
709	  }
710	
711	  // =
712	  // ALLOC Router: At most one alloc request is allowed to stay within the whole resource table
713	  // =
714	  val (alloc_cuid_group, alloc_cuid_local) = convert_cu_id(io.alloc.bits.cu_id)
715	  val alloc_decoupledio = Module(new DecoupledIO_1_to_3(handler_lds_io(0).alloc.bits, handler_sgpr_io(0).alloc.bits, handler_vgpr_io(0).alloc.bits))
716	  // Alloc request recorder
717	  val alloc_record = RegInit(false.B)
718	  alloc_record := MuxCase(alloc_record, Seq(
719	    io.alloc.fire -> true.B,
720	    io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire -> false.B,
721	  ))
722	  val alloc_allowed = WireInit(!alloc_record || io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire)
723	  // Valid-ready
724	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.valid := io.alloc.valid && alloc_allowed
725	  io.alloc.ready := alloc_decoupledio.io.in.ready && alloc_allowed
726	  // LDS
727	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.cu_id := io.alloc.bits.cu_id
728	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.wg_slot_id := io.alloc.bits.wg_slot_id
729	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.num_resource := io.alloc.bits.num_lds
730	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.cu_id_local := alloc_cuid_local
731	  // SGPR
732	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.cu_id := io.alloc.bits.cu_id
733	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.wg_slot_id := io.alloc.bits.wg_slot_id
734	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.num_resource := io.alloc.bits.num_sgpr
735	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.cu_id_local := alloc_cuid_local
736	  // VGPR
737	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.cu_id := io.alloc.bits.cu_id
738	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.wg_slot_id := io.alloc.bits.wg_slot_id
739	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.num_resource := io.alloc.bits.num_vgpr
740	  alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.cu_id_local := alloc_cuid_local
741	  // DEBUG
742	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
743	    alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.wg_id.get := io.alloc.bits.wg_id.get
744	    alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.wg_id.get := io.alloc.bits.wg_id.get
745	    alloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.wg_id.get := io.alloc.bits.wg_id.get
746	  }
747	  // resource table handler
748	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
749	    handler_lds_io(i).alloc.valid := false.B
750	    handler_lds_io(i).alloc.bits := DontCare  // default value if it is not connected by MUX
751	    handler_sgpr_io(i).alloc.valid := false.B
752	    handler_sgpr_io(i).alloc.bits := DontCare
753	    handler_vgpr_io(i).alloc.valid := false.B
754	    handler_vgpr_io(i).alloc.bits := DontCare
755	  }
756	  // Bi-direction MUX
757	  alloc_decoupledio.io.out0 <> handler_lds_io(alloc_cuid_group).alloc
758	  alloc_decoupledio.io.out1 <> handler_sgpr_io(alloc_cuid_group).alloc
759	  alloc_decoupledio.io.out2 <> handler_vgpr_io(alloc_cuid_group).alloc
760	
761	
762	  // =
763	  // DEALLOC: (DecoupledIO 2-to-1)
764	  // 1. Router to RT handler (DecoupledIO 3-to-1)
765	  // 2. WG slot & WF slot dealloc (to allocator)
766	  // =
767	
768	  val dealloc_decoupledio = Module(new DecoupledIO_1_to_3(handler_lds.head.io.dealloc.bits, handler_sgpr.head.io.dealloc.bits, handler_vgpr.head.io.dealloc.bits, IGNORE = true))
769	  val slot_dealloc = Module(new Queue(new io_rt2dealloc, 2))
770	
771	  // DecoupledIO 2-to-1 valid-ready
772	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.valid := io.dealloc.valid && slot_dealloc.io.enq.ready
773	  slot_dealloc.io.enq.valid := io.dealloc.valid && dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.ready
774	  io.dealloc.ready := dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.ready && slot_dealloc.io.enq.ready
775	
776	  // WG slot & WF slot dealloc
777	  slot_dealloc.io.enq.bits := io.dealloc.bits
778	  io.slot_dealloc <> slot_dealloc.io.deq
779	
780	  val (dealloc_cuid_group, dealloc_cuid_local) = convert_cu_id(io.dealloc.bits.cu_id)
781	  // LDS
782	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.cu_id := io.dealloc.bits.cu_id
783	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.wg_slot_id := io.dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id
784	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.cu_id_local := dealloc_cuid_local
785	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.ign0.get := !io.dealloc.bits.lds_dealloc_en  // if num_lds=0, no need to dealloc this WG
786	  // SGPR
787	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.cu_id := io.dealloc.bits.cu_id
788	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.wg_slot_id := io.dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id
789	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.cu_id_local := dealloc_cuid_local
790	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.ign1.get := !io.dealloc.bits.sgpr_dealloc_en
791	  // VGPR
792	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.cu_id := io.dealloc.bits.cu_id
793	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.wg_slot_id := io.dealloc.bits.wg_slot_id
794	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.cu_id_local := dealloc_cuid_local
795	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.ign2.get := !io.dealloc.bits.vgpr_dealloc_en
796	  // DEBUG
797	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
798	    dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data0.wg_id.get := io.dealloc.bits.wg_id.get
799	    dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data1.wg_id.get := io.dealloc.bits.wg_id.get
800	    dealloc_decoupledio.io.in.bits.data2.wg_id.get := io.dealloc.bits.wg_id.get
801	  }
802	  // resource table handler
803	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
804	    handler_lds_io(i).dealloc.valid := false.B
805	    handler_lds_io(i).dealloc.bits := DontCare  // default value if it is not connected by MUX
806	    handler_sgpr_io(i).dealloc.valid := false.B
807	    handler_sgpr_io(i).dealloc.bits := DontCare
808	    handler_vgpr_io(i).dealloc.valid := false.B
809	    handler_vgpr_io(i).dealloc.bits := DontCare
810	  }
811	  // Bi-direction MUX
812	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.out0 <> handler_lds_io(dealloc_cuid_group).dealloc
813	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.out1 <> handler_sgpr_io(dealloc_cuid_group).dealloc
814	  dealloc_decoupledio.io.out2 <> handler_vgpr_io(dealloc_cuid_group).dealloc
815	
816	  // =
817	  // resource table result (rtcache update) Router
818	  // =
819	  val rtcache_lds_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
820	  val rtcache_sgpr_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
821	  val rtcache_vgpr_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
822	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
823	    rtcache_lds_valid(i) := handler_lds(i).io.rtcache_update.valid
824	    rtcache_sgpr_valid(i) := handler_sgpr(i).io.rtcache_update.valid
825	    rtcache_vgpr_valid(i) := handler_vgpr(i).io.rtcache_update.valid
826	  }
827	
828	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
829	    handler_lds_io(i).rtcache_update.ready := false.B
830	    handler_sgpr_io(i).rtcache_update.ready := false.B
831	    handler_vgpr_io(i).rtcache_update.ready := false.B
832	  }
833	  io.rtcache_lds <> handler_lds_io(PriorityEncoder(rtcache_lds_valid)).rtcache_update
834	  io.rtcache_sgpr <> handler_sgpr_io(PriorityEncoder(rtcache_sgpr_valid)).rtcache_update
835	  io.rtcache_vgpr <> handler_vgpr_io(PriorityEncoder(rtcache_vgpr_valid)).rtcache_update
836	
837	  // =
838	  // Base address router
839	  // =
840	  val baseaddr_lds_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
841	  val baseaddr_sgpr_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
842	  val baseaddr_vgpr_valid = Wire(Vec(NUM_HANDLER, Bool()))
843	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
844	    baseaddr_lds_valid(i)  := handler_lds(i).io.baseaddr.valid
845	    baseaddr_sgpr_valid(i) := handler_sgpr(i).io.baseaddr.valid
846	    baseaddr_vgpr_valid(i) := handler_vgpr(i).io.baseaddr.valid
847	  }
848	  for(i <- 0 until NUM_HANDLER) {
849	    handler_lds_io(i).baseaddr.ready  := false.B
850	    handler_sgpr_io(i).baseaddr.ready := false.B
851	    handler_vgpr_io(i).baseaddr.ready := false.B
852	  }
853	  val baseaddr_lds_reg  = Queue(handler_lds_io(PriorityEncoder(baseaddr_lds_valid)).baseaddr  , entries=1, pipe=true, flow=true)
854	  val baseaddr_sgpr_reg = Queue(handler_sgpr_io(PriorityEncoder(baseaddr_sgpr_valid)).baseaddr, entries=1, pipe=true, flow=true)
855	  val baseaddr_vgpr_reg = Queue(handler_vgpr_io(PriorityEncoder(baseaddr_vgpr_valid)).baseaddr, entries=1, pipe=true, flow=true)
856	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.valid := baseaddr_lds_reg.valid && baseaddr_sgpr_reg.valid && baseaddr_vgpr_reg.valid
857	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.bits.lds_base  := baseaddr_lds_reg.bits.addr
858	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.bits.sgpr_base := baseaddr_sgpr_reg.bits.addr
859	  io.cuinterface_wg_new.bits.vgpr_base := baseaddr_vgpr_reg.bits.addr
860	  baseaddr_lds_reg.ready  := io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire
861	  baseaddr_sgpr_reg.ready := io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire
862	  baseaddr_vgpr_reg.ready := io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire
863	
864	  if(CONFIG.DEBUG) {
865	    when(io.cuinterface_wg_new.fire) {
866	      assert(baseaddr_lds_reg.bits.wg_id.get === baseaddr_sgpr_reg.bits.wg_id.get)
867	      assert(baseaddr_lds_reg.bits.wg_id.get === baseaddr_vgpr_reg.bits.wg_id.get)
868	    }
869	    io.cuinterface_wg_new.bits.wg_id.get := baseaddr_lds_reg.bits.wg_id.get
870	  }
871	
872	  // Since at most 1 alloc request is allowed to allowed to stay in resource_table_top,
873	  //  there are at most 1 valid baseaddr result
874	  assert(PopCount(baseaddr_lds_valid)  <= 1.U)
875	  assert(PopCount(baseaddr_sgpr_valid) <= 1.U)
876	  assert(PopCount(baseaddr_vgpr_valid) <= 1.U)
877	}

262	  io.coreReq.ready := true.B//!memRsp_Q.io.deq.valid && !mshrAccess.io.missRspOut.valid//mshrAccess.io.missReq.ready //&& !coreRsp_QAlmstFull
263

58	class getEntryStatus(nEntry: Int) extends Module{
59	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
60	    val valid_list = Input(UInt(nEntry.W))
61	    //val alm_full = Output(Bool())
62	    val full = Output(Bool())
63	    val next = Output(UInt(log2Up(nEntry).W))
64	    val used = Output(UInt())
65	  })
66	
67	  io.used := PopCount(io.valid_list)
68	  //io.alm_full := io.used === (nEntry.U-1.U)

73	class MSHR[T <: Data](val tIgen: T)(implicit val p: Parameters) extends L1CacheModule{
74	  //TODO parameterization method need improvement
75	  val tIWidth = tIgen.getWidth
76	  //val bAWidth = bABits.getWidth
77	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
78	    val missReq = Flipped(Decoupled(new MSHRmissReq(bABits,tIWidth,WIdBits,asidLen)))
79	    val missRspIn = Flipped(Decoupled(new MSHRmissRspIn(bABits)))
80	    val missRspOut = Decoupled(new MSHRmissRspOut(bABits,tIWidth,asidLen))
81	    val miss2mem = Decoupled(new MSHRmiss2mem(bABits,WIdBits,asidLen,NMshrEntry))
82	  })
83	  // head of entry, for comparison
84	  val blockAddr_Access = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(0.U(bABits.W))))
85	  val targetInfo_Accesss = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrSubEntry)(0.U(tIWidth.W))))))
86	
87	  /*Structure Diagram
88	  * bA  : blockAddr
89	  * tI  : targetInfo
90	  * e_v : entry_valid, which is the first column of s_v
91	  * s_v : subentry_valid
92	  * h_s : has_send2mem
93	  *
94	  * reg   +reg   +reg        || reg + reg array
95	  * h_s(0)+s_v(0)+bA#0       || tI#0 | s_v(1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(n)+tI#NMshrSubEntry-1
96	  * h_s(1)+s_v(1)+bA#1       || tI#0 | s_v(1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(n)+tI#NMshrSubEntry-1
97	  * .
98	  * h_s(n)+s_v(n)+bA#NMshrEntry  || tI#0 | s_v(1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(n)+tI#NMshrSubEntry-1
99	  * */
100	
101	  //  ******     decide selected subentries are full or not     ******
102	  val entryMatchMissRsp = Wire(UInt(log2Up(NMshrEntry).W))
103	  val entryMatchMissReq = Wire(UInt(NMshrEntry.W))
104	  val subentry_valid = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrSubEntry)(0.U(1.W))))))
105	  val subentry_selected = subentry_valid(entryMatchMissRsp)
106	  val subentryStatus = Module(new getEntryStatus(NMshrSubEntry))// Output: alm_full, full, next
107	  subentryStatus.io.valid_list := Reverse(Cat(subentry_selected))
108	  val subentry_next2cancel = Wire(UInt(log2Up(NMshrSubEntry).W))
109	  subentry_next2cancel := subentry_selected.indexWhere(_===true.B)
110	
111	  //  ******     decide MSHR is full or not     ******
112	  val entry_valid = Reverse(Cat(subentry_valid.map(Cat(_).orR)))
113	  val entryStatus = Module(new getEntryStatus(NMshrEntry))
114	  entryStatus.io.valid_list := entry_valid
115	
116	  val hasSendStatus = Module(new getEntryStatus(NMshrEntry))
117	  val missRspIn_bA = Wire(UInt(bABits.W))
118	
119	  val missRsqBusy = RegInit(false.B)
120	  val missRspInHoldingIdx = Wire(UInt(log2Up(NMshrEntry).W))
121	  missRspInHoldingIdx := Mux(missRsqBusy,RegNext(missRspInHoldingIdx),io.missRspIn.bits.EntryIdx)
122	  entryMatchMissRsp := missRspInHoldingIdx//Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_===missRspInHoldingbA))) & entry_valid
123	  //assert(PopCount(entryMatchMissRsp) <= 1.U)
124	 //Block addr and asid match indicate same req
125	  assert(PopCount(entryMatchMissReq) <= 1.U)
126	  //  ******     decide a primary miss or a secondary miss     ******
127	  val secondary_miss = entryMatchMissReq.orR
128	  val primary_miss = !secondary_miss
129	
130	  //  ******     update MSHR when missReq     ******
131	  val ReqConflictWithRsp = Wire(Bool())
132	  io.missReq.ready := !((entryStatus.io.full && primary_miss) ||
133	    (subentryStatus.io.full && secondary_miss) || ReqConflictWithRsp)
134	
135	  val tAEntryIdx = Mux(secondary_miss,OHToUInt(entryMatchMissReq),entryStatus.io.next)
136	  val tASubEntryIdx = Mux(secondary_miss,subentryStatus.io.next,0.U)
137	
138	  when (io.missReq.fire){
139	    targetInfo_Accesss(tAEntryIdx)(tASubEntryIdx) := io.missReq.bits.targetInfo
140	  }
141	if(MMU_ENABLED) {
142	  val ASID_Access = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(0.U(asidLen.W))))
143	  entryMatchMissReq := Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_===io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid & Reverse(Cat(ASID_Access.map(_===io.missReq.bits.ASID.get)))
144	  io.missRspOut.bits.ASID.get := ASID_Access(entryMatchMissRsp)
145	  when(io.missReq.fire && primary_miss){
146	    ASID_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.ASID.get
147	  }
148	  io.miss2mem.bits.ASID.get := ASID_Access(hasSendStatus.io.next)
149	  val missRspIn_ASID = Wire(UInt(asidLen.W))
150	  missRspIn_ASID := ASID_Access(io.missRspIn.bits.EntryIdx)
151	  ReqConflictWithRsp := io.missReq.valid &&
152	    ((io.missRspIn.fire && missRspIn_bA === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr && missRspIn_ASID === io.missReq.bits.ASID.get) ||
153	      (missRsqBusy && io.missRspOut.bits.blockAddr === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))
154	} else {
155	  entryMatchMissReq := Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_===io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid
156	  ReqConflictWithRsp := io.missReq.valid &&
157	    ((io.missRspIn.fire && missRspIn_bA === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr) ||
158	      (missRsqBusy && io.missRspOut.bits.blockAddr === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))
159	}
160	
161	  //  ******      update MSHR when missRsp    ******
162	
163	  assert(!io.missRspIn.fire || (io.missRspIn.fire && subentryStatus.io.used >= 1.U))
164	
165	
166	  when(io.missRspIn.fire && (subentryStatus.io.used =/= 1.U || !io.missRspOut.ready)){
167	    missRsqBusy := true.B
168	  }.elsewhen(missRsqBusy && subentryStatus.io.used === 1.U && io.missRspOut.ready){
169	    missRsqBusy := false.B
170	  }
171	
172	  io.missRspIn.ready := !missRsqBusy && io.missRspOut.ready
173	  io.missRspOut.valid := io.missRspIn.fire || missRsqBusy
174	
175	  io.missRspOut.bits.targetInfo := targetInfo_Accesss(entryMatchMissRsp)(subentry_next2cancel)
176	  io.missRspOut.bits.blockAddr := blockAddr_Access(entryMatchMissRsp)
177	
178	
179	  //  ******     maintain subentries    ******
180	  for (iofEn <- 0 until NMshrEntry){
181	    for (iofSubEn <- 0 until NMshrSubEntry){
182	      when(io.missReq.fire){
183	        when(iofEn.asUInt===entryStatus.io.next &&
184	          iofSubEn.asUInt===0.U && primary_miss){
185	          subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := true.B
186	        }.elsewhen(iofEn.asUInt===OHToUInt(entryMatchMissReq) &&
187	          iofSubEn.asUInt===subentryStatus.io.next && secondary_miss){
188	          subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := true.B
189	        }.elsewhen(io.missRspOut.fire &&
190	          iofEn.asUInt === entryMatchMissRsp &&
191	          iofSubEn.asUInt === subentry_next2cancel){
192	          subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := false.B
193	        }
194	      }.elsewhen(io.missRspOut.fire &&
195	        iofEn.asUInt===entryMatchMissRsp &&
196	        iofSubEn.asUInt===subentry_next2cancel){
197	        subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := false.B
198	      }
199	    }//order of when & elsewhen matters, as elsewhen cover some cases of when, but no op to them
200	  }
201	
202	  //  ******   update blockAddr Reg *****
203	  when(io.missReq.fire && primary_miss){
204	    blockAddr_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.blockAddr
205	  }
206	
207	  //  ******    handle miss to lower mem    ******
208	  val has_send2mem = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(0.U(1.W))))
209	
210	  hasSendStatus.io.valid_list := ~(~Reverse(Cat(has_send2mem)) & entry_valid)
211	  io.miss2mem.valid := !has_send2mem(hasSendStatus.io.next) && entry_valid(hasSendStatus.io.next)
212	  val miss2mem_fire = io.miss2mem.valid && io.miss2mem.ready
213	
214	  for (i <- 0 to NMshrEntry){
215	    when(miss2mem_fire && i.U === hasSendStatus.io.next){
216	      has_send2mem(i.U) := true.B
217	    }.elsewhen((missRsqBusy || io.missRspIn.fire) && io.missRspOut.fire && subentryStatus.io.used===1.U && i.U === entryMatchMissRsp){
218	      has_send2mem(i.U) := false.B//missRsp, L2 to core
219	    }
220	  }
221	  io.miss2mem.bits.blockAddr := blockAddr_Access(hasSendStatus.io.next)
222	  io.miss2mem.bits.instrId := hasSendStatus.io.next
223	
224	  missRspIn_bA := blockAddr_Access(io.missRspIn.bits.EntryIdx)
225	
226	  //  ******    ReqConflictWithRsp
227	  //missRspIn fire或者busy时，missReq来了block addr相同的请求，置高此信号
228	
229	}

12	class DCacheWSHR(Depth:Int) extends Module{
13	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
14	    //push
15	    val pushReq = Flipped(DecoupledIO(new WSHRreq))
16	    val conflict = Output(Bool())
17	    val pushedIdx = Output(UInt(log2Up(Depth).W))
18	    //for invOrFlu
19	    val empty = Output(Bool())
20	    //pop
21	    val popReq = Flipped(ValidIO(UInt(log2Up(Depth).W)))
22	  })
23	 // assert(!(io.pushReq.valid && io.popReq.valid),"WSHR cant pop and push in same cycle")
24	
25	  val blockAddrEntries = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(Depth)(0.U((paLen - dcache_BlockOffsetBits - dcache_WordOffsetBits).W))))
26	  val valid: Vec[Bool] = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(Depth)(false.B)))
27	  io.empty := !valid.reduceTree(_|_)
28	
29	  //following circuit are same to L1TagAccess.scala tagChecker
30	  val pushMatchMask = Wire(UInt(Depth.W))
31	  pushMatchMask := Reverse(Cat(blockAddrEntries.zip(valid).map{
32	    case(bA,valid) => (bA === io.pushReq.bits.blockAddr) && valid}))
33	  assert(PopCount(pushMatchMask) <= 1.U,"WSHR dont store same bA in 2 entries")
34	  io.conflict := pushMatchMask.orR
35	
36	  //pushReq.ready := !full
37	  io.pushReq.ready := !valid.reduceTree(_ & _)
38	
39	  val nextEntryIdx = valid.indexWhere((x: Bool) => x === false.B)
40	  val PopPushInSameCycle = io.pushReq.fire && io.popReq.fire
41	  io.pushedIdx := Mux(PopPushInSameCycle,io.popReq.bits,nextEntryIdx)
42	  when(io.pushReq.fire && io.popReq.fire){
43	    blockAddrEntries(io.popReq.bits) := io.pushReq.bits.blockAddr
44	    valid(io.popReq.bits) := true.B
45	  }.elsewhen(io.pushReq.fire){
46	    blockAddrEntries(nextEntryIdx) := io.pushReq.bits.blockAddr
47	    valid(nextEntryIdx) := true.B
48	  }.elsewhen(io.popReq.valid){
49	    valid(io.popReq.bits) := false.B
50	  }
51	}

62	  val BankConfArb = Module(new BankConflictArbiter)
63	  //val TagAccess = Module(new L1TagAccess(set=NSets, way=NWays, tagBits=TagBits))
64	  val DataCorssBarForWrite = Module(new DataCrossbar)

33	class ByteEn1HConvertor(BytesOfWord:Int=4) extends Module{
34	  //wordOffset one-hot converter, based on Byte Enable signal and wordOffset
35	  def WordOffsetBits = log2Up(BytesOfWord)
36	  val io=IO(new Bundle{
37	    val wordOffset = Input(UInt(WordOffsetBits.W))
38	    val byteEn = Input(UInt(2.W))
39	    val wordOffset1H = Output(UInt(BytesOfWord.W))
40	    val alignmentError = Output(Bool())
41	  })
42	  io.alignmentError := true.B
43	  io.wordOffset1H := Fill(BytesOfWord,"b1".U)
44	  switch(io.byteEn){
45	    is(0.U){
46	      io.alignmentError := false.B
47	      io.wordOffset1H := UIntToOH(io.wordOffset)
48	    }
49	    is(1.U){
50	      io.alignmentError := io.wordOffset(0)// === true.B
51	      io.wordOffset1H := Cat(Fill(BytesOfWord/2,io.wordOffset(1)),Fill(BytesOfWord/2,!io.wordOffset(1)))
52	    }
53	    is(3.U){
54	      io.alignmentError := io.wordOffset.orR
55	      io.wordOffset1H := Fill(BytesOfWord,true.B)
56	    }
57	  }
58	}

102	class BankConflictArbiter(implicit p: Parameters) extends ShareMemModule{
103	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
104	    val coreReqArb = Input(new coreReqArb)
105	
106	    val dataCrsbarSel1H = Output(Vec(NBanks, UInt(NBanks.W)))
107	    val addrCrsbarOut = Output(Vec(NBanks, new AddrBundle1T))
108	    val dataArrayEn = Output(Vec(NBanks, Bool()))
109	    val activeLane = Output(Vec(NLanes,Bool()))
110	
111	    val bankConflict = Output(Bool())
112	    val bankConflict_isWrite = Output(Bool())
113	  })
114	  //announcement
115	  val bankConflict = Wire(Bool())
116	  val bankConflict_reg = RegNext(bankConflict,false.B)
117	  val conflictReqIsW_reg = Reg(Bool())
118	  val perLaneReq = Wire(Vec(NLanes, new coreReqArb1T))
119	  val perLaneConflictReq_reg = Reg(Vec(NLanes, new coreReqArb1T))
120	  val perLaneConflictReq = Wire(Vec(NLanes, new coreReqArb1T))
121	  (0 until NLanes).foreach{i =>
122	    perLaneReq(i).activeMask := io.coreReqArb.perLaneAddr(i).activeMask
123	    perLaneReq(i).bankIdx := io.coreReqArb.perLaneAddr(i).blockOffset(BankIdxBits-1,0)
124	    if(BlockOffsetBits>BankIdxBits){
125	      perLaneReq(i).AddrBundle.bankOffset.foreach(_:= io.coreReqArb.perLaneAddr(i).blockOffset(BlockOffsetBits-1,BankIdxBits))}
126	    else{
127	      //perLaneReq(i).AddrBundle.bankOffset :=Wire(UInt())
128	    }
129	    perLaneReq(i).AddrBundle.wordOffset1H := io.coreReqArb.perLaneAddr(i).wordOffset1H
130	  }
131	
132	  //**************detect bank conflict**************
133	  val bankIdx = Wire(Vec(NLanes, UInt(BankIdxBits.W)))
134	  val isWrite: Bool = Mux(bankConflict_reg,conflictReqIsW_reg,io.coreReqArb.isWrite)
135	  val laneActiveMask = Wire(Vec(NLanes, Bool()))
136	  val bankIdx1H = Wire(Vec(NLanes, UInt(NBanks.W)))
137	  val bankIdxMasked = Wire(Vec(NLanes, UInt(NBanks.W)))
138	  (0 until NLanes).foreach{ i =>
139	    laneActiveMask(i) := perLaneConflictReq(i).activeMask
140	    bankIdx(i) := perLaneConflictReq(i).bankIdx
141	    bankIdx1H(i) := UIntToOH(bankIdx(i))
142	    bankIdxMasked(i) := bankIdx1H(i) & Fill(NLanes, laneActiveMask(i))}
143	  val perBankReq_Bin = Wire(Vec(NBanks, UInt(NLanes.W)))//transpose of bankIdxMasked
144	  val perBankReqCount = Wire(Vec(NBanks, UInt((log2Up(NLanes)+1).W)))
145	  (0 until NBanks).foreach{ i =>
146	    perBankReq_Bin(i) := Reverse(Cat(bankIdxMasked.map(_(i))))
147	    perBankReqCount(i) := PopCount(perBankReq_Bin(i))}
148	  /*
149	  *  perBankReq1H(j)
150	  *    |
151	  * 0 |1| 0  0  //bankIdx1H(i)
152	  *    +
153	  * 1 |0| 0  0  //bankIdx1H(i+1)
154	  *    =
155	  *    1 //perBankReqCount(i)
156	  */
157	  val perBankReqConflict = Wire(Vec(NBanks, Bool()))
158	  perBankReqConflict := perBankReqCount.map(_>1.U)
159	  bankConflict := Cat(perBankReqConflict).orR && (io.coreReqArb.enable || bankConflict_reg)
160	  //TODO is there a better logic detecting bankConflict?
161	
162	  //**************reserve conflict req**************
163	  val perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H = Wire(Vec(NBanks, UInt(NLanes.W)))
164	  perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H := perBankReq_Bin.map(Cat(_)).map(PriorityEncoderOH(_))
165	  val ActiveLaneWhenConflict1H = Wire(Vec(NLanes, Bool()))
166	  (0 until NBanks).foreach{ i =>
167	    ActiveLaneWhenConflict1H(i) := Cat(perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H.map(_(i))).orR}
168	  val ReserveLaneWhenConflict1H = VecInit(((~Cat(ActiveLaneWhenConflict1H)).asUInt & Cat(laneActiveMask)).asBools.reverse)
169	
170	  perLaneConflictReq := Mux(bankConflict_reg,perLaneConflictReq_reg,perLaneReq)
171	  //to determine current arb source: during a conflict, use Reg, otherwise use Input
172	  (0 until NLanes).foreach{ i =>
173	    when(ReserveLaneWhenConflict1H(i)){
174	      perLaneConflictReq_reg(i).bankIdx := perLaneConflictReq(i).bankIdx
175	      perLaneConflictReq_reg(i).AddrBundle := perLaneConflictReq(i).AddrBundle}
176	    perLaneConflictReq_reg(i).activeMask := ReserveLaneWhenConflict1H(i)
177	  }
178	  when(bankConflict){conflictReqIsW_reg := io.coreReqArb.isWrite}
179	
180	  //**************output to AddrCrossbar**************
181	  io.addrCrsbarOut := L2BCrossbar(NBanks,perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H,VecInit(perLaneConflictReq.map(_.AddrBundle)))
182	
183	  //**************output to DataCrossbar**************
184	  //do not merge req to same addr from different lane. assume this optimization to be done at register level
185	  io.dataCrsbarSel1H := Mux(isWrite,perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H,bankIdxMasked)
186	
187	  //**************output to DataArray**************
188	  io.dataArrayEn := perBankActiveLaneWhenConflict1H.map(_.orR)
189	  io.bankConflict := bankConflict//to pull down coreReq.ready
190	  io.bankConflict_isWrite := isWrite
191	
192	  //**************output to coreRsp****************
193	  io.activeLane := ActiveLaneWhenConflict1H
194	}

106	  val entry_valid = Reverse(Cat(subentry_valid.map(Cat(_).orR)))
107	  val probestatus = RegInit(false.B)
108	  val MSHR_st1 = Module(new Queue(new MSHRpipe1Reg(NMshrEntry,log2Up(NMshrSubEntry)+1),1,true,false))
109	  val releasing_stall = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(false.B)))
110	
111	  io.releasing_stall := releasing_stall.asUInt.orR
112	  io.empty := !entry_valid.orR
113	  io.probestatus := MSHR_st1.io.deq.valid//probestatus
114	  /*Structure Diagram
115	  * bA  : blockAddr
116	  * tI  : targetInfo
117	  * iI  : instrId
118	  * e_v : entry_valid, which is the first column of s_v
119	  * s_v : subentry_valid
120	  * N : NMshrEntry
121	  * n : NMshrSubEntry
122	  *
123	  * reg     +reg +reg    || SRAM
124	  * s_v(0,0)+bA#0+iI#0   || tI#0 | s_v(0,1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(N,n)+tI#n
125	  * s_v(1,0)+bA#1+iI#1   || tI#0 | s_v(1,1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(N,n)+tI#n
126	  * .
127	  * .
128	  * .
129	  * s_v(N,0)+bA#N+iI#N   || tI#0 | s_v(N,1)+tI#1 | ... | s_v(N,n)+tI#n
130	  *
131	  * for dcache, every missRep tI include iI, but only useful when this request is primary miss
132	  * this iI will be recorded as iI for this missing cache line fetch request to L2
133	  * */
134	
135	  //  ******     missReq decide selected subentries are full or not     ******
136	  val entryMatchMissRsp = Wire(UInt(log2Up(NMshrEntry).W))
137	  val entryMatchProbe = Wire(UInt(NMshrEntry.W))
138	  val entryMatchProbeid_reg = Wire(UInt(NMshrEntry.W))
139	  val allfalse_subentryvalidtype = Wire(Vec(NMshrSubEntry,Bool()))
140	  for (i<-0 until NMshrSubEntry){
141	    allfalse_subentryvalidtype(i) := false.B
142	  }
143	  val subentrySelectedForReq = Mux(entryMatchProbe===0.U,allfalse_subentryvalidtype, subentry_valid(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe)))
144	  val subentryStatus = Module(new getEntryStatusReq(NMshrSubEntry)) // Output: alm_full, full, next
145	  subentryStatus.io.valid_list := Reverse(Cat(subentrySelectedForReq))
146	
147	  //  ******     missRsp status      ******
148	  val subentryStatusForRsp = Module(new getEntryStatusRsp(NMshrSubEntry))
149	  val missRspprobeReqSameBlock = Wire(Bool())
150	
151	  //  ******     missReq decide MSHR is full or not     ******
152	  val entryStatus = Module(new getEntryStatusReq(NMshrEntry))
153	  entryStatus.io.valid_list := entry_valid
154	
155	  // ******     enum vec_mshr_status     ******
156	  val mshrStatus_st1_r = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
157	  val mshrStatus_st1_w = Wire(UInt(3.W))
158	  val mshrStatus_st0 = Wire(UInt(3.W))
159	  io.mshrStatus_st0 := mshrStatus_st0
160	  /*PRIMARY_AVAIL         000
161	  * PRIMARY_FULL          001
162	  * SECONDARY_AVAIL       010
163	  * SECONDARY_FULL        011
164	  * SECONDARY_FULL_RETURN 100
165	  * PRIMARY_ALM_FULL      101
166	  * SECONDARY_ALM_FULL    111
167	  * see as always valid, validity relies on external procedures
168	  * */
169	  // ******      mshr::probe_vec    ******
170	  if(MMU_ENABLED){
171	    val ASID_Access = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(NMshrEntry)(0.U(AsidBits.W))))
172	    val missRspASID_st0 = ASID_Access(entryMatchMissRsp)
173	    entryMatchProbe := Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_ === io.probe.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid & Reverse(Cat(ASID_Access.map(_ === io.probeAsid.get)))
174	    entryMatchProbeid_reg := OHToUInt(Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_ === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid & Reverse(Cat(ASID_Access.map(_ === io.missReqAsid.get))))
175	    when(io.missReq.fire && MSHR_st1.io.deq.ready && mshrStatus_st1_w === 0.U) { //PRIMARY_AVAIL
176	      blockAddr_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.blockAddr
177	      instrId_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.instrId
178	      ASID_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReqAsid.get
179	    }
180	    val missRspOutAsid_st1 = Module(new Queue(UInt(AsidBits.W),1,true,false))
181	    missRspOutAsid_st1.io.enq.bits := missRspASID_st0
182	    missRspOutAsid_st1.io.enq.valid := io.missRspIn.valid && !(subentryStatusForRsp.io.used===0.U)
183	    missRspOutAsid_st1.io.deq.ready := io.missRspOut.ready
184	    io.missRspOutAsid.foreach(_ := missRspOutAsid_st1.io.deq.bits)
185	    missRspprobeReqSameBlock := (io.probe.bits.blockAddr === io.missRspOut.bits.blockAddr) && (io.probeAsid.get === io.missRspOutAsid.get)
186	  } else {
187	    entryMatchProbe := Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_ === io.probe.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid
188	    when(io.missReq.fire && MSHR_st1.io.deq.ready && mshrStatus_st1_w === 0.U) { //PRIMARY_AVAIL
189	      blockAddr_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.blockAddr
190	      instrId_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.instrId
191	    }
192	    entryMatchProbeid_reg := OHToUInt(Reverse(Cat(blockAddr_Access.map(_ === io.missReq.bits.blockAddr))) & entry_valid)
193	    missRspprobeReqSameBlock := (io.probe.bits.blockAddr === io.missRspOut.bits.blockAddr)
194	  }
195	
196	  assert(PopCount(entryMatchProbe) <= 1.U)
197	//RegEnable(OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe),io.missReq.fire)
198	  val secondaryMiss = MSHR_st1.io.deq.bits.entryMatchProbe.orR
199	  val secondaryMiss_st0 = entryMatchProbe.orR
200	  val primaryMiss_st0 = !secondaryMiss_st0
201	  val primaryMiss = !secondaryMiss
202	  val mainEntryFull = entryStatus.io.full
203	  val mainEntryAlmFull = entryStatus.io.alm_full
204	  val subEntryFull = subentryStatus.io.full
205	  val subEntryAlmFull = subentryStatus.io.alm_full
206	  //MSHR pipe reg st1, input
207	  MSHR_st1.io.enq.valid := io.probe.valid
208	  MSHR_st1.io.enq.bits.entryMatchProbe := entryMatchProbe
209	  MSHR_st1.io.enq.bits.subEntryIdx := subentryStatus.io.next
210	  MSHR_st1.io.deq.ready := io.stage1_ready
211	
212	  when(io.missReq.fire && !io.probe.valid && io.stage2_ready) {
213	    when(primaryMiss && mainEntryAlmFull) {
214	      mshrStatus_st1_r := 1.U //PRIMARY_FULL
215	    }.elsewhen(secondaryMiss && subEntryAlmFull) {
216	      mshrStatus_st1_r := 3.U //SECONDARY_FULL
217	    }
218	  }.elsewhen(io.probe.valid) {
219	    when(primaryMiss_st0) {
220	      when(mainEntryFull || (mainEntryAlmFull && io.missReq.fire)) {
221	        mshrStatus_st1_r := 1.U //PRIMARY_FULL
222	        //}.elsewhen(mainEntryAlmFull) {
223	        //  mshrStatus_st1 := 5.U //PRIMARY_ALM_FULL
224	      }.otherwise {
225	        mshrStatus_st1_r := 0.U //PRIMARY_AVAIL
226	      }
227	    }.otherwise {
228	      when(subEntryFull) {
229	        mshrStatus_st1_r := 3.U //SECONDARY_FULL
230	        //}.elsewhen(subEntryAlmFull) {
231	        //  mshrStatus_st1 := 7.U //SECONDARY_ALM_FULL
232	      }.otherwise {
233	        mshrStatus_st1_r := 2.U //SECONDARY_AVAIL
234	      }
235	    }
236	  }.elsewhen(io.missRspIn.valid) {
237	    //assert(!(mshrStatus_st1_r === 4.U),"mshr set SECONDARY_FULL_RETURN incorrectly")
238	    when(mshrStatus_st1_r === 1.U || mshrStatus_st1_r === 2.U) {
239	      mshrStatus_st1_r := 0.U //PRIMARY_AVAIL
240	    }.elsewhen(mshrStatus_st1_r === 3.U && subentryStatusForRsp.io.used === 1.U) {
241	      mshrStatus_st1_r := 4.U //SECONDARY_FULL_RETURN
242	    }.elsewhen(mshrStatus_st1_r === 4.U && subentryStatusForRsp.io.used === 0.U) {
243	      mshrStatus_st1_r := 0.U //SECONDARY_AVAIL
244	    }
245	  }
246	
247	  when(primaryMiss_st0) {
248	    when(mainEntryFull || io.missReq.valid && mainEntryAlmFull) {
249	      mshrStatus_st0 := 1.U //PRIMARY_FULL
250	      //}.elsewhen(mainEntryAlmFull) {
251	      //  mshrStatus_st1 := 5.U //PRIMARY_ALM_FULL
252	    }.otherwise {
253	      mshrStatus_st0 := 0.U //PRIMARY_AVAIL
254	    }
255	  }.otherwise {
256	    when(subEntryFull || io.missReq.valid && subEntryAlmFull) {
257	      mshrStatus_st0 := 3.U //SECONDARY_FULL
258	      //}.elsewhen(subEntryAlmFull) {
259	      //  mshrStatus_st1 := 7.U //SECONDARY_ALM_FULL
260	    }.elsewhen(missRspprobeReqSameBlock && io.missRspOut.valid){
261	      mshrStatus_st0 := 4.U // miss rsp return
262	    }.otherwise {
263	      mshrStatus_st0 := 2.U //SECONDARY_AVAIL
264	    }
265	  }
266	
267	
268	  // mshrStatus_st0 := mshrStatus_st1_w
269	  val entryMatchProbe_st1 = MSHR_st1.io.deq.bits.entryMatchProbe//RegEnable(entryMatchProbe, io.probe.valid)
270	  val subEntryIdx_st1 = MSHR_st1.io.deq.bits.subEntryIdx
271	  //mshrStatus依赖primaryMiss和SecondaryMiss，它们依赖entryValid。
272	  //mshrStatus必须是寄存器，需要在probe valid的下个周期正确显示。entryValid更新的下一个周期已经来不及。
273	  //所以用组合逻辑加工一次mshrStatus。
274	  when(secondaryMiss && (mshrStatus_st1_r === 0.U || mshrStatus_st1_r === 1.U)&& io.stage2_ready) {
275	    when(subEntryFull) {
276	      mshrStatus_st1_w := 3.U //SECONDARY_FULL
277	    }.otherwise {
278	      mshrStatus_st1_w := 2.U //SECONDARY_AVAIL
279	    }
280	  }.otherwise {
281	    mshrStatus_st1_w := mshrStatus_st1_r
282	  }
283	  io.probeOut_st1.probeStatus := mshrStatus_st1_w
284	  when(io.probe.fire && !probestatus) {
285	    probestatus := true.B
286	  }.elsewhen(probestatus) {
287	    when(io.probe.bits.blockAddr =/= io.missReq.bits.blockAddr && io.missReq.fire) {
288	      probestatus := io.probe.fire
289	    }.elsewhen(io.missReq.fire) {
290	      probestatus := false.B
291	    }
292	  }
293	  //  ******     mshr::allocate_vec_sub/allocate_vec_main     ******
294	  /*0:PRIMARY_AVAIL 1:PRIMARY_FULL 2:SECONDARY_AVAIL 3:SECONDARY_FULL*/
295	  io.missReq.ready := !(mshrStatus_st1_w === 1.U || mshrStatus_st1_w === 3.U )
296	  assert(!io.missReq.fire || (io.missReq.fire && !io.missRspIn.fire), "MSHR cant have Req & Rsp valid in same cycle, later the prior")
297	  val real_SRAMAddrUp = Mux(secondaryMiss, OHToUInt(entryMatchProbe_st1), entryStatus.io.next)
298	  val real_SRAMAddrDown = Mux(secondaryMiss, MSHR_st1.io.deq.bits.subEntryIdx, 0.U)
299	  when(io.missReq.fire && MSHR_st1.io.deq.ready) {
300	    targetInfo_Accesss(real_SRAMAddrUp)(real_SRAMAddrDown) := io.missReq.bits.targetInfo
301	  }
302	
303	 /* when(io.missReq.fire && MSHR_st1.io.deq.ready && mshrStatus_st1_w === 0.U) { //PRIMARY_AVAIL
304	    blockAddr_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.blockAddr
305	    instrId_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.instrId
306	    ASID_Access(entryStatus.io.next) := io.missReq.bits.ASID
307	  }*/
308	
309	  io.probeOut_st1.a_source := Mux(io.missReq.valid,real_SRAMAddrUp,entryMatchProbeid_reg)
310	
311	  //  ******      mshr::vec_arrange_core_rsp    ******
312	  subentryStatusForRsp.io.valid_list := Reverse(Cat(subentry_valid(entryMatchMissRsp)))
313	  // priority: missRspIn > missReq
314	  //assert(!io.missRspIn.fire || (io.missRspIn.fire && subentryStatus.io.used >= 1.U))
315	  //This version allow missRspIn fire when no subentry are left
316	  //如果后面发现missRspOut端口这一级不能取消，使用这段注释掉的代码
317	  //io.missRspIn.ready := !(subentryStatusForRsp.io.used >= 2.U ||
318	  //  (subentryStatusForRsp.io.used === 1.U && !io.missRspOut.ready))
319	  io.missRspIn.ready := !((subentryStatusForRsp.io.used >= 1.U) ||
320	    ((mshrStatus_st1_w === 4.U || mshrStatus_st1_w === 3.U) && subentryStatusForRsp.io.used === 1.U) ||
321	    io.missReq.valid)
322	
323	  entryMatchMissRsp := io.missRspIn.bits.instrId
324	  //entryMatchMissRsp := Reverse(Cat(instrId_Access.map(_ === io.missRspIn.bits.instrId))) & entry_valid
325	  //assert(PopCount(entryMatchMissRsp) <= 1.U,"MSHR missRspIn, cant match multiple entries")
326	  val subentry_next2cancel = Wire(UInt(log2Up(NMshrSubEntry).W))
327	  subentry_next2cancel := subentryStatusForRsp.io.next2cancel
328	
329	  val missRspTargetInfo_st0 = targetInfo_Accesss(entryMatchMissRsp)(subentry_next2cancel)
330	  val missRspBlockAddr_st0 = blockAddr_Access(entryMatchMissRsp)
331	  //val missRspASID_st0 = ASID_Access(entryMatchMissRsp)
332	  val missRspOut_st1 = Module(new Queue(new MSHRmissRspOut(bABits, tIWidth, WIdBits, AsidBits),1,true,false))
333	  missRspOut_st1.io.enq.valid := io.missRspIn.valid && !(subentryStatusForRsp.io.used===0.U)
334	  missRspOut_st1.io.enq.bits.targetInfo := missRspTargetInfo_st0
335	  missRspOut_st1.io.enq.bits.blockAddr := missRspBlockAddr_st0
336	  missRspOut_st1.io.enq.bits.instrId := io.missRspIn.bits.instrId
337	  //missRspOut_st1.io.enq.bits.ASID := missRspASID_st0
338	
339	  io.missRspOut <> missRspOut_st1.io.deq
340	  //io.missRspOut := RegNext(io.missRspIn.valid) &&
341	  //  subentryStatusForRsp.io.used >= 1.U//如果上述Access中改出SRAM，本信号需要延迟一个周期
342	
343	  //  ******     maintain subentries    ******
344	  /*0:PRIMARY_AVAIL 1:PRIMARY_FULL 2:SECONDARY_AVAIL 3:SECONDARY_FULL*/
345	  for (iofEn <- 0 until NMshrEntry) {
346	    for (iofSubEn <- 0 until NMshrSubEntry) {
347	      when(iofEn.asUInt === entryStatus.io.next &&
348	        iofSubEn.asUInt === 0.U && io.missReq.fire  && MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire && primaryMiss) {
349	        subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := true.B
350	      }.elsewhen(iofEn.asUInt === entryMatchMissRsp && iofSubEn.asUInt === subentry_next2cancel &&
351	        io.missRspIn.valid && missRspOut_st1.io.enq.ready) {
352	        subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := false.B
353	      }
354	    }.elsewhen(iofSubEn.asUInt === subEntryIdx_st1 &&
355	      io.missReq.fire && secondaryMiss && MSHR_st1.io.deq.fire && iofEn.asUInt === entryMatchProbeid_reg) {
356	      subentry_valid(iofEn)(iofSubEn) := true.B
357	    } //order of when & elsewhen matters, as elsewhen cover some cases of when, but no op to them
358	  }
359	
360	  for (iofEn <- 0 until NMshrEntry) {
361	    when(iofEn.asUInt === entryMatchMissRsp && io.missRspIn.fire && releasing_stall(iofEn)) {
362	      releasing_stall(iofEn) := false.B
363	    }.elsewhen(iofEn.asUInt === entryMatchMissRsp && io.missRspIn.valid && !releasing_stall(iofEn)) {
364	      releasing_stall(iofEn) := true.B
365	    } 
366	  }
367	}

40	class genControl extends Module{
41	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
42	    val opcode = Input(UInt(3.W))
43	    val param = Input(UInt(4.W))
44	    val control = Output(new DCacheControl())
45	  })
46	  io.control.isRead := false.B
47	  io.control.isWrite := false.B
48	  io.control.isLR := false.B
49	  io.control.isSC := false.B
50	  io.control.isAMO := false.B
51	  io.control.isFlush := false.B
52	  io.control.isInvalidate := false.B
53	  io.control.isWaitMSHR := false.B
54	
55	  switch(io.opcode){
56	    is(0.U){
57	      when(io.param === 0.U){
58	        io.control.isRead := true.B
59	      }.elsewhen(io.param === 1.U) {
60	        io.control.isLR := true.B
61	      }
62	    }
63	    is(1.U){
64	      when(io.param === 0.U) {
65	        io.control.isWrite := true.B
66	      }.elsewhen(io.param === 1.U) {
67	        io.control.isSC := true.B
68	      }
69	    }
70	    is(2.U){
71	      io.control.isAMO := true.B
72	    }
73	    is(3.U){
74	      when(io.param === 0.U) {
75	        io.control.isInvalidate := true.B
76	      }.elsewhen(io.param === 1.U) {
77	        io.control.isFlush := true.B
78	      }.elsewhen(io.param === 2.U){
79	        io.control.isWaitMSHR := true.B
80	      }
81	    }
82	  }
83	}

85	class genDataMapPerByte(numdata:Int, NLanes:Int) extends Module{
86	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
87	    val OriData = Input(Vec(numdata,UInt(NLanes.W)))
88	    val offsetMask = Input(Vec(numdata,UInt(4.W)))
89	    val DataOut = Output(Vec(numdata,UInt(NLanes.W)))
90	  })
91	  for(i <- 0 until numdata){
92	    when(io.offsetMask(i).andR){
93	      io.DataOut(i) := io.OriData(i)
94	    }.elsewhen(PopCount(io.offsetMask(i))=== 1.U){
95	      io.DataOut(i) := io.OriData(i) << (OHToUInt(io.offsetMask(i)) << 3)
96	    }.elsewhen(io.offsetMask(i)(3,2) === 3.U){
97	      io.DataOut(i) := io.OriData(i) << 16
98	    }.otherwise{
99	      io.DataOut(i) := io.OriData(i)
100	    }
101	  }
102	}

113	  val dataRemap = Wire(Vec(NLanes,Vec(NLanes,UInt(WordLength.W))))
114	  for(i<- 0 until NLanes){
115	    for(j<- 0 until NLanes){
116	      when(io.perLaneAddr(i).activeMask && io.perLaneAddr(j).activeMask){
117	        blockOffsetMatch(i)(j) := io.perLaneAddr(i).blockOffset === io.perLaneAddr(j).blockOffset
118	      }.otherwise{
119	        blockOffsetMatch(i)(j) := false.B
120	      }
121	    }
122	  }
123	  for(i<- 0 until NLanes){
124	    io.perLaneAddrRemap(i).blockOffset := io.perLaneAddr(i).blockOffset
125	    io.perLaneAddrRemap(i).activeMask := io.perLaneAddr(i).activeMask
126	    io.perLaneAddrRemap(i).wordOffset1H := wordOffsetRemap(i).reduce(_|_)
127	    io.dataout(i) := dataRemap(i).reduce(_|_)
128	    for(j <-0 until NLanes){
129	      wordOffsetRemap(i)(j) := Mux(blockOffsetMatch(i)(j),io.perLaneAddr(j).wordOffset1H,0.U)
130	      dataRemap(i)(j) := Mux(blockOffsetMatch(i)(j),io.datain(j),0.U)
131	    }
132	
133	  }
134	}

347	class ReplacementUnit(timeLength:Int, way: Int, debug:Boolean=false) extends Module{
348	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
349	    val validOfSet = Input(UInt(way.W))//MSB at left
350	    val timeOfSet_st1 = Input(Vec(way,UInt(timeLength.W)))//MSB at right
351	    val waymask_st1 = Output(UInt(way.W))
352	    val Set_is_full = Output(Bool())
353	  })
354	  val wayIdxWidth = log2Ceil(way)
355	  val victimIdx = if (way>1) Wire(UInt(wayIdxWidth.W)) else Wire(UInt(1.W))
356	  io.Set_is_full := io.validOfSet === Fill(way,1.U)
357	
358	  if (way>1) {
359	    val timeOfSetAfterValid = Wire(Vec(way,UInt(timeLength.W)))
360	    for (i <- 0 until way)
361	      timeOfSetAfterValid(i) := Mux(io.validOfSet(i),io.timeOfSet_st1(i),0.U)
362	    val minTimeChooser = Module(new minIdxTree(width=timeLength,numInput=way))
363	    minTimeChooser.io.candidateIn := timeOfSetAfterValid
364	    victimIdx := minTimeChooser.io.idxOfMin
365	  }else victimIdx := 0.U
366	
367	  io.waymask_st1 := UIntToOH(Mux(io.Set_is_full, victimIdx, PriorityEncoder(~io.validOfSet)))
368	  // First case, set not full
369	  //Second case, full set, replacement happens
370	
371	  //debug use
372	  if(debug){
373	    when(io.validOfSet.asBools.reduce(_ | _) === true.B) {
374	      printf(io.validOfSet.asBools.map{ x => p"${x} " }.reduceOption(_ + _).getOrElse(p"") + p"\n" +
375	             io.timeOfSet_st1.reverse.map{ x => p"${x} " }.reduceOption(_ + _).getOrElse(p"") +
376	             p"\noutput: ${io.waymask_st1}\n")
377	    }
378	  }
379	}

412	class minIdxTree(width: Int, numInput: Int) extends Module{
413	  val treeLevel = log2Ceil(numInput)
414	  val io = IO(new Bundle{
415	    val candidateIn = Input(Vec(numInput, UInt(width.W)))
416	    val idxOfMin = Output(UInt(treeLevel.W))
417	  })
418	  class candWithIdx extends Bundle{
419	    val candidate = UInt(width.W)
420	    var index = UInt(treeLevel.W)
421	  }
422	  def minWithIdx(a:candWithIdx, b:candWithIdx): candWithIdx = Mux(a.candidate < b.candidate,a,b)
423	
424	  val candVec = Wire(Vec(numInput,new candWithIdx))
425	  for(i <- 0 until numInput){
426	    candVec(i).candidate := io.candidateIn(numInput-1-i)
427	    candVec(i).index := i.asUInt
428	  }
429	
430	  io.idxOfMin := candVec.reduceTree(minWithIdx(_,_)).index
431	}

521	  if (way>1) victim_1Hidx := RegEnable(Cat(victim_1Hidx(way-2,0),victim_1Hidx(way-1)),io.Set_is_full)

89	  val rowBits = log2Ceil(rowEntries)
90	  val numBanks = rowBytes / params.micro.writeBytes
91	  val codeBits = 8*params.micro.writeBytes
92	  val singlePort= false
93	  val cc_banks = Module(new SRAMTemplate(UInt(codeBits.W), set=rowEntries, way=numBanks,
94	        shouldReset=false, holdRead=false, singlePort=singlePort,bypassWrite = false))  //single bank so far

111	  io.sourceD_radr.ready:=true.B

268	  cache:  CacheParameters,
269	  micro:  InclusiveCacheMicroParameters,
270	  control: Boolean,

272	  outer:  TLEdgeOut)//(implicit val p: Parameters)
273	{
274	  require (cache.ways > 1)
275	  require (cache.sets > 1 && isPow2(cache.sets))
276	  require (micro.writeBytes <= inner.manager.beatBytes)
277	  require (micro.writeBytes <= outer.manager.beatBytes)
278	  require (inner.manager.beatBytes <= cache.blockBytes)
279	  require (outer.manager.beatBytes <= cache.blockBytes)
280	
281	  // Require that all cached address ranges have contiguous blocks
282	  outer.manager.managers.flatMap(_.address).foreach { case a =>
283	    require (a.alignment >= cache.blockBytes)
284	  }
285	
286	  // If we are the first level cache, we do not need to support inner-BCE
287	  val firstLevel = !inner.client.clients.exists(_.supports.probe)
288	  // If we are the last level cache, we do not need to support outer-B
289	  val lastLevel = !outer.manager.managers.exists(_.regionType > RegionType.UNCACHED)

292	  // Provision enough resources to achieve full throughput with missing single-beat accesses
293	  val mshrs = InclusiveCacheParameters.all_mshrs(cache, micro)
294	  val secondary = max(mshrs, micro.memCycles - mshrs)
295	  val putLists = micro.memCycles // allow every request to be single beat
296	  val putBeats = max(2*cache.blockBeats, micro.memCycles)
297	  val relLists = 2
298	  val relBeats = relLists*cache.blockBeats
299	
300	  val flatAddresses = AddressSet.unify(outer.manager.managers.flatMap(_.address))
301	  val pickMask = AddressDecoder(flatAddresses.map(Seq(_)), flatAddresses.map(_.mask).reduce(_|_))
302	
303	  def bitOffsets(x: BigInt, offset: Int = 0, tail: List[Int] = List.empty[Int]): List[Int] =
304	    if (x == 0) tail.reverse else bitOffsets(x >> 1, offset + 1, if ((x & 1) == 1) offset :: tail else tail)
305	  val addressMapping = bitOffsets(pickMask)
306	  val addressBits = addressMapping.size
307	
308	  // println(s"addresses: ${flatAddresses} => ${pickMask} => ${addressBits}")
309	
310	  val allClients = inner.client.clients.size
311	  val clientBitsRaw = inner.client.clients.filter(_.supports.probe).size
312	  val clientBits = max(1, clientBitsRaw)
313	  val stateBits = 2
314	
315	  val wayBits    = log2Ceil(cache.ways)
316	  val setBits    = log2Ceil(cache.sets)
317	  val offsetBits = log2Ceil(cache.blockBytes)
318	  val tagBits    = addressBits - setBits - offsetBits
319	  val putBits    = log2Ceil(max(putLists, relLists))
320	
321	  require (tagBits > 0)
322	  require (offsetBits > 0)
323	
324	  val innerBeatBits = offsetBits - log2Ceil(inner.manager.beatBytes)
325	  val outerBeatBits = offsetBits - log2Ceil(outer.manager.beatBytes)
326	  val innerMaskBits = inner.manager.beatBytes / micro.writeBytes
327	  val outerMaskBits = outer.manager.beatBytes / micro.writeBytes
328	
329	  def clientBit(source: UInt): UInt = {
330	    if (clientBitsRaw == 0) {
331	      0.U
332	    } else {
333	      Cat(inner.client.clients.filter(_.supports.probe).map(_.sourceId.contains(source)).reverse)
334	    }
335	  }
336	
337	  def clientSource(bit: UInt): UInt = {
338	    if (clientBitsRaw == 0) {
339	      0.asUInt
340	    } else {
341	      Mux1H(bit, inner.client.clients.filter(_.supports.probe).map(c => c.sourceId.start.U))
342	    }
343	  }
344	
345	  def parseAddress(x: UInt): (UInt, UInt, UInt) = {
346	    val offset = Cat(addressMapping.map(o => x(o,o)).reverse)
347	    val set = offset >> offsetBits
348	    val tag = set >> setBits
349	    (tag(tagBits-1, 0), set(setBits-1, 0), offset(offsetBits-1, 0))
350	  }
351	
352	  def widen(x: UInt, width: Int): UInt = {
353	    val y = x | 0.U(width.W)
354	    //assert (y >> width === UInt(0))
355	    y(width-1, 0)
356	  }
357	
358	  def expandAddress(tag: UInt, set: UInt, offset: UInt): UInt = {
359	    val base = Cat(widen(tag, tagBits), widen(set, setBits), widen(offset, offsetBits))
360	    var bits = Array.fill(outer.bundle.addressBits) { 0.U(1.W) }
361	    addressMapping.zipWithIndex.foreach { case (a, i) => bits(a) = base(i,i) }
362	    Cat(bits.reverse)
363	  }

366	    val missingBits = flatAddresses
367	      .map { a => (a.widen(pickMask).base, a.widen(~pickMask)) } // key is the bits to restore on match
368	      .groupBy(_._1)
369	      .mapValues(_.map(_._2))
370	    val muxMask = AddressDecoder(missingBits.values.toList)
371	    val mux = missingBits.toList.map { case (bits, addrs) =>
372	      val widen = addrs.map(_.widen(~muxMask))
373	      val matches = AddressSet
374	        .unify(widen.distinct)
375	        .map(_.contains(expanded))
376	        .reduce(_ || _)
377	      (matches, bits.U)
378	    }
379	    expanded | Mux1H(mux)
380	  }

383	    if (micro.dirReg) RegEnable(x, en) else x
384	  }

387	    cover(cond, "CCACHE_L" + cache.level + "_" + label, "MemorySystem;;" + desc)
388	}

393	  def INVALID: UInt = 0.U(stateBits.W) // way is empty
394	  def BRANCH:  UInt = 1.U(stateBits.W) // outer slave cache is trunk
395	  def TRUNK:   UInt = 2.U(stateBits.W) // unique inner master cache is trunk
396	  def TIP:     UInt = 3.U(stateBits.W) // we are trunk, inner masters are branch
397	
398	  // Does a request need trunk?
399	  def needT(opcode: UInt, param: UInt): Bool = {
400	    !opcode(2) ||
401	    (opcode === TLMessages.Hint && param === TLHints.PREFETCH_WRITE) ||
402	    ((opcode === TLMessages.AcquireBlock || opcode === TLMessages.AcquirePerm) && param =/= TLPermissions.NtoB)
403	  }
404	  // Does a request prove the client need not be probed?
405	  def skipProbeN(opcode: UInt): Bool = {
406	    // Acquire(toB) and Get => is N, so no probe
407	    // Acquire(*toT) => is N or B, but need T, so no probe
408	    // Hint => could be anything, so probe IS needed
409	    // Put* => is N or B, so probe IS needed
410	    opcode === TLMessages.AcquireBlock || opcode === TLMessages.AcquirePerm || opcode === TLMessages.Get
411	  }
412	  def isToN(param: UInt): Bool = {
413	    param === TLPermissions.TtoN || param === TLPermissions.BtoN || param === TLPermissions.NtoN
414	  }
415	  def isToB(param: UInt): Bool = {
416	    param === TLPermissions.TtoB || param === TLPermissions.BtoB
417	  }
418	}

1 # Top 2 3 # 概述 4 5 线程块调度器的顶层结构如图，模块之间的蓝色箭头代表主通路 6 7 ​![top_general](assets/top_general-20240411105338-o344lfa.png)​ 8 9 线程块调度器主要分为4大组件，其最基本功能如下： 10 11 1. WG buffer 12 13 * 缓存Host发来的线程块 14 * 从缓存起来的线程块中挑选一个，发送到allocator 15 * 接收Allocator返回的判定结果，若线程块被接受需读取WG RAM2中的信息发送给CU interface 16 2. Allocator 17 18 * 从WG buffer接收待判定的线程块相关信息 19 * 对线程块做如下两项处理（核心功能） 20 21 * 决定对这个线程块来说各CU的优先级 22 * 检验各CU剩余资源能否容纳此线程块（依据RTcache中缓存的空闲资源片段大小） 23 * （这两条操作相互独立，可以并行或任意先后顺序） 24 * 综合上述两条处理的结果，得出判定结论 25 26 * 若所有CU均不能容纳此线程块，丢弃其信息，重新开始 27 * 若至少一个CU能容纳此线程块，从中挑选优先级最高的CU 28 * 向Resouce table发送alloc请求，等待生成各资源的Base Address 29 * 向WG buffer发送分配结果（拒绝/接受），请求读取WG Ram2中的线程块信息 30 * 将成功分配的线程块传递给CU interface 31 3. Resource table 32 33 * 利用链表记录运行中的WG占用资源片段的Base Address与Size 34 * 接收到alloc或dealloc请求时更新链表 35 * 对alloc请求，扫描链表，寻找一个合适的Base Address 36 * alloc/dealloc结束后扫描链表，找到最大的几个空闲资源片段，将其大小汇报给allocator 37 4. CU interface 38 39 * 从allocator接收线程块，记录其线程束数量 40 * 将线程块拆分为线程束，逐个发送给目标CU 41 * 从各CU接收执行完毕的线程束，找到对应的线程块记录，将剩余线程束数量减1 42 * 若某一线程块记录的线程束数量变为0，说明此线程块执行完毕，通知Resouce table释放资源，并汇报给Host 43 44 # 优化目标 45 46 最关心的是GPU整体的吞吐率，也就是最右侧向Host回报线程块已完成的吞吐率 47 48 全路径中的吞吐率瓶颈应当在CU，而不在线程块调度器 49 50 线程块调度器的主要优化目标是通过调度策略简介提高CU吞吐率，而线程块调度器自身的吞吐率并不关键 51 52 # 细化 53 54 1. CTA调度器总共需要处理5类资源，其中LDS/sGPR/vGPR处理逻辑在Resource table中实现，WG/WF slot处理逻辑简单因而平铺到Allocator中 55 56 |资源种类|给定用量|判定容纳|生成基址|存储方式|处理方式| 57 | ----------| ----------| ----------| ----------| ----------| ------------| 58 |LDS|✓
|✓|✓|链表|遍历| 59 |sGPR|✓|✓|✓|链表|遍历| 60 |vGPR|✓|✓|✓|链表|遍历| 61 |WG slot|const 1|✓|✓|Bool数组|优先级编码| 62 |WF slot|✓|✓||计数器|比较| 63 64 > 关于WG slot：这是一种在CTA调度器中使用的资源，它是： 65 > 66 > 1. Resource table链表底层的一维RAM的一个位置，因此一个CU的链表最多存储NUM_WG_SLOT个线程块 67 > 2. CU interface中用于记录线程块已完成WF数量的WF counter reg，以及记录此线程块WF总数量的reg 68 > 69 2. WG/WF slot也需要dealloc，但WG slot的dealloc不能早于LDS/sGPR/vGPR的dealloc，因为链表项是存储在WG slot上的，必须先解除占用再dealloc 70 或者两者在同一周期开始也可以，因为RT dealloc删除链表项的操作是原子的 71 本实现中WG/WF slot会经过resource table转发以确保WG slot的dealloc时机正确 72 3. 线程块可以不消耗某类资源，则此线程块不会写入到这种资源的链表中 73 Allocator也会生成三种delloc_en信号，告知此线程块最终需要从哪些链表中dealloc 74 75 ​![top_refined](assets/top_refined-20240411082423-v93wwpf.png)​ 76

1	# Allocator
2	
3	> 缩写词：Resouce Table = RT
4	
5	# 整体功能
6	
7	Allocator的功能：决定将线程块分配到哪一个能容纳它的CU上（或拒绝分配），也就是将如下两项相互独立功能的结果综合起来
8	
9	* 功能1：CU优先级抉择
10	* 功能2：CU资源可容纳判定
11	
12	本实现先判定CU优先级，再自最高优先级起逐个CU做资源判定，直到找到一个能够容纳的CU，完成分配，状态机图如下：
13	
14	1. 在ResouceCheck状态，从最高优先级的CU起，每周期判定`step`​个CU是否能够容纳此线程块，直到找到一个能容纳的CU或发现所有CU均不能容纳为止
15	
16	    * 若某个CU被判定无法容纳，但同时此CU的RTcache被更新，说明发生了新的dealloc，可以重新判定。
17	    * 即使原先已经判定可以容纳，也需要重新判定一次，因为之后alloc改写RTcache时需要作为判定副产物的RTcache表项地址
18	2. 在Alloc状态，完成以下几项内容：
19	
20	    * 向CU interface发送线程块信息
21	    * 更新RTcache内容
22	    * 向Resouce table发出alloc请求以求取BaseAddr并改写资源表
23	3. 在Alloc状态必须关注维护RTcache内容的有效性
24	
25	    * 本状态在Resource Table接收alloc请求前，禁止alloc目标CU的RTcache被更新(ready=false)，因为新的alloc请求即将发出，此时RT给出的结果已经失效
26	    * Resouce table接收到一个alloc请求后，必须立即清空此CU已经或正在生成的RT result，因为它们已经失效
27	    * 事实上RTcache写锁定应当从RTcache被读取的第一个周期开始，但RecouceCheck状态有重读功能，规避了此问题
28	
29	![allocator_fsm](assets/allocator_fsm-20240410181154-9exzmc2.png)
30	
31	# Resouce table cache
32	
33	Allocator中存在Resource table cache（RTcache)，储存着Resource table找到的空闲资源片段大小size
34	
35	* Allocator只利用RTcache做容纳性判定，即使这可能与实际情况不完全相符
36	* RTcache中每项具有~~valid位~~与size字段。只要某项是valid的，就应当且能够保证CU中至少存在一个大小≥size的空闲资源片段
37	
38	  * 更新：Valid字段不必要，将对应Size字段置零效果相同
39	  * 在一次alloc后将size扣除被alloc的值即可，其内容仍然有效
40	  * 将Size字段的语义设置为“大于等于”，而不是原有实现中的“等于”，优势如下：
41	
42	    * 使Size字段的有效时间大大延长。若设置为等于，任何dealloc都将使得所有Size记录完全失效，暂时剥夺此CU参与资源判定的资格。而剥夺高优先级CU的判定资格将可能使GPU整体性能下降
43	* RTcache中可能存有多项 ~~，每项都代表一个独立的空闲资源片段~~，向一个片段alloc不影响另一个片段的valid性
44	
45	  * 可以保证刚刚cache update时，各项所代表的空闲资源片段是独立的（由resouce table保证）
46	  * 无法保证一段时间后多项之间的独立性：因为dealloc可以将两段本独立的资源片段融合为一段
47	  * 但仍可以保证向一个片段alloc不影响另一个片段的valid性：
48	
49	    * 若两个片段已经或即将被融合成一个片段，则新片段大小size > size0 + size1，即使扣除全部size0，也仍能保证size ≥ size1
50	* 由于Resource table处理数据缓慢，RTcache无法时刻持有真实数据
51	
52	  * RTcache设计目标：任何时候保证资源不超量分配
53	  * RTcache与实际情况同步时（上次更新RTcache后此CU再未有alloc/dealloc行为），RTcache的容纳性判定结果与实际完全一致  
54	    因为此时RTcache中必定存有最大空闲资源片段的大小
55	  * RTcache与实际情况不同步时（此CU的RT有正在处理的alloc/dealloc还未更新RTcache），RTcache只能保证不超量分配资源  
56	    此时RTcache中的数据可以理解为对实际情况的最坏预估
57	  * 可以增加RTcache中的记录项数以使RTcache的最坏预估更加贴合实际情况，从而使Allocator的容纳性判定更贴合实际情况
58	  * 在alloc/dealloc不频繁的情况下，大多数时候RTcache的数据能够与实际情况同步
59	  * > 原有实现中在RTcache无法同步实际情况时直接剥夺此CU的容纳性判定资格，而不是在保证不超量分配的前提下对实际情况做估计
60	    >
61	* Allocator按照固定优先级来使用RTcache中的项：第0项优先级最低，resouce table应当将更大的资源片段放置在低位
62	* Allocator假定将WG分配到它选定的资源片段，只因这是Allocator视角的最坏预估，但实际并不总是如此
63	
64	  * BaseAddr采用Lazy求值的方式，在确定将线程块分配到CUx上后再由CUx的Resouce table来求取一个BaseAddr
65	  * RT求取BaseAddr时会选取一个能容纳此线程块的最小片段，而不总是使用最大片段，这样更好地防止资源碎片化
66	  * 示例：某CU的RTcache中缓存了size0=5, size1=3  
67	    现有一线程块要求资源量为2，由于size1=3表明有一片大小至少为3的片段，一定可以容纳，allocator决定将线程块分配到此CU上  
68	    allocator假定此线程块分配到大小至少为3的片段上，更新size1=1  
69	    RT开始求取BaseAddr，若最终将线程块分配到size1对应片段，则语义正确；  
70	    若最终将线程块分配到了其他更合适的片段，则3>size1=1，语义正确。
71	
72	​![rtcache](assets/rtcache-20240329163619-v806uep.svg)​
73	
74	在原有实现中，RTcache中缓存了资源片段的BaseAddr，并将其作为最终分配线程块的BaseAddr。这项功能被移除的原因：
75	
76	* 原有实现RTcache中Size字段的语义是最大资源片段的大小（不是大于等于），BaseAddr字段的语义是最大资源片段的首地址
77	* 新实现中cache中不保存BaseAddr并用作WG资源基地址的原因
78	
79	  * RT可以在任意空闲时刻接收dealloc请求，但是并不能即使更新RTcache（需要扫描链表来生成结果）
80	  * 如果将BaseAddr字段定义为片段首地址，则一旦有dealloc请求则此CU的RTcache立即失效，必须等待
81	
82	    * 可能更优的方式：对BaseAddr采用Lazy求值的思想，在确定将线程块分配到CUx上后再由CUx的Resouce table来求取一个BaseAddr
83	  * 如果将BaseAddr字段定义为保证Size字段有效的一个片段中的任意地址，则会在将线程块alloc到资源片段中间，造成资源碎片化，不可接受
84	* 新实现中BaseAddr字段Lazy求值的优劣
85	
86	  * 在dealloc很频繁时，Lazy求值将多次RT扫描合并为1次，吞吐量上升（优势）
87	  * 否则，Lazy求值将使Allocator处理一个线程块的耗时增加，吞吐量下降（劣势）
88	  * Lazy求值能够得到更优的BaseAddr：选取一个能容纳线程块的最小片段，而不总是使用最大片段，更好地防止资源碎片化（决定性的优势)
89	  * 通常来说，alloc与dealloc都是极不频繁的操作，Allocator吞吐量下降可能是很小的代价，而防止资源碎片化能够优化GPU整体性能
90

30	输入输出（全部为DecoupledIO）与数据处理
31	
32	* 收到alloc请求：对应的Table handler遍历链表寻找合适的BaseAddr，写入RTram，发送BaseAddr。激活scan。
33	* 收到dealloc请求：对应的Table handler删除链表项，激活scan。将WG/WF slot的dealloc请求转发给Allocator
34	* BaseAddr输出接口：一个Table handler处理完一个alloc请求后发出一个BaseAddr
35	* cache update输出接口：一个Table handler完成一次链表scan后更新Allocator中的RTcache
36	* 激活scan ≠ scan将完成并更新RTcache，因为scan可以被alloc或dealloc请求抢占

40	* Resouce Table收到CUx的Alloc请求后

42	  * 立即清除CUx已生成的RT result
43	  * 立即放弃CUx正在生成的RT result
44	* 整个Resouce Table（所有CU）在同一时刻只能处理同一个alloc请求

46	  * 因为从alloc到BaseAddr的路径不是顺序（先入者先出）的，如此才能保证CU interface接收到的三路信息属于同一个线程块（其他两路是顺序的）
47	  * 可以在Router中监视alloc请求的进入与完成（`alloc.fire`​与`BaseAddr.fire`​），存在一个正在处理的alloc请求时强制`alloc.ready = false`​

50	  * 最低位给出的片段在Allocator中优先级最低（推荐为最大片段）

69	
70	## 功能1：转发alloc与dealloc请求
71	
72	依据alloc与dealloc两个DecoupledIO中传递的CU ID信息来接通对应的Table handler。
73	
74	在空闲时刻应当输出ready置0，而不能连接到任意table handler
75	
76	alloc与dealloc各有一套独立的Router路径，互不干扰
77	
78	注意：Router禁止缓存alloc请求，禁止缓存RT result，因为alloc请求一旦接收就必须表明对应CU的RT result已经全部清空
79	
80	如果Router用于仲裁请求的组合逻辑链路过长，可以使用状态机拆分为多周期，但从alloc/dealloc请求到Table handler之间仅能有一层MUX
81	
82	三种资源RT router可以共享仲裁逻辑，因为对于alloc与dealloc总是同时面向三种资源
83	
84	## 功能2：转发BaseAddr
85	
86	将BaseAddr端口valid = true的Table handler的BaseAddr端口连接到输出端即可
87	
88	需要将三种资源的BaseAddr输出通过一个3-to-1 DecoupledIO合并为一个再作为总输出

90	当前实现中同一时刻不可能有两个Table handler同时给出有效的BaseAddr，因为当前实现中发出一个alloc请求后Allocator会阻塞等待BaseAddr

92	## 功能3：转发RT result
93	
94	转发Table handler给出的cache update数据（即RT result）
95	
96	可能有多个Table handler同时给出RT result，优先级不重要
97	
98	注意：Router禁止缓存RT result，因为alloc请求一旦接收就必须表明对应CU的RT result已经全部清空，所以路由路径上只能使用MUX

127	## alloc过程
128	
129	伪代码：
130	
131	step0. 链表初始化
132	
133	```c
134	struct rt_node{
135	    struct rt_node *prev;
136	    struct rt_node *next;
137	    unsigned addr1;
138	    unsigned addr2;
139	}
140	
141	// Module init
142	unsigned rt_node_cnt = 0;       // 链表中存在WG的数量
143	struct rt_node *head = NULL; 	// 指向链表的第一个WG
144	struct rt_node *tail = NULL;    // 指向链表的最后一个WG
145	#define MAXSIZE NUM_RESOURCE
146	#define MAXADDR (NUM_RESOURCE - 1)
147	#define NULL    DONTCARE 
148	```
149	
150	step1. 求取BaseAddr
151	
152	```c
153	// FSM state init
154	unsigned select_size = MAXSIZE;         // 被选中空闲片段的大小。allocator已经确定此CU一定能容纳此WG
155	unsigned select_addr = 0;               // 被选中空闲片段的首地址
156	struct rt_node *select_ptr1 = NULL; 	// 被选中的空闲片段前的WG
157	struct rt_node *select_ptr2 = NULL;     // 被选中的空闲片段后的WG
158	bool tail_flag = true                   // 被选中的空闲片段位于链表末尾
159	bool head_flag = true                   // 被选中的空闲片段位于链表头
160	
161	if(req_size == 0) goto step2
162	
163	//if(rt_node_cnt != 0){                 // 有无这个if不影响最终结果的正确性，但对于rt_node_cnt == 0的情况可以节省一个周期
164	    // FSM state init
165	    struct rt_node *ptr1 = NULL; 	// 首次先检验第一片k被占用片段前是否有空闲资源片段
166	    struct rt_node *ptr2 = head;
167	    for(unsigned cnt = 0; cnt <= rt_node_cnt; cnt++) {
168	        unsigned addr2 = (cnt == rt_node_cnt) ? MAXADDR : ptr2->addr1 - 1; 	// 这一空闲片段的最末地址
169	        unsigned addr1 = (cnt == 0) ? -1 : ptr1->addr2;                     // 这一空闲片段的首地址 - 1
170	        unsigned size = addr2 - addr1;                                      // 这一空闲片段的大小
171	        select_size = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? size : select_size;
172	        select_addr = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? addr1 + 1 : select_addr;
173	        select_ptr1 = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? ptr1 : select_ptr1;
174	        select_ptr2 = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? ptr2 : select_ptr2;
175	        tail_flag = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? (cnt == rt_node_cnt) : tail_flag;
176	        head_flag = (size > req_size && size < select_size) ? (cnt == 0) : tail_flag;
177	
178	        ptr1 = ptr2;
179	        ptr2 = ptr2->next;
180	        // clock step
181	    }
182	//}
183	```
184	
185	step2. 写入 & 输出BaseAddr
186	
187	```C
188	// FSM state init
189	struct rt_node *this = wg_slot_id;
190	
191	fork {
192	    if(req_size != 0) {
193		    this->prev = select_ptr1;
194		    this->next = select_ptr2;
195		    this->addr1 = baseaddr
196		    this->addr2 = baseaddr + req_size - 1
197		    head = (select_addr == 0) ? this : head; 	  // 因ALLOC导致head改变 <=> Alloc BaseAddr必为0
198		    head = head_flag ? this : head;               // 等价
199		    tail = tail_flag ? this : tail;
200		    rt_node_cnt += 1;
201		    // clock step
202		    if(!head_flag) select_ptr1->next = this;      // 若这将成为首节点，ptr1中是无效数据
203		    if(!tail_flag) select_ptr2->prev = this;      // 若这将成为尾节点，ptr2中是无效数据
204	    }
205	} .fork {
206	    while(!toCUinterface.fire){
207	        toCUinterface.data = select_addr;
208	        toCUinterface.valid = true;
209	        // clock step
210	    }
211	}.join
212	```

214	## dealloc过程
215	
216	伪代码：
217	
218	```c
219	struct rt_node *this = wg_slot_id;
220	// clock step
221	struct rt_node *prev = this->prev;
222	struct rt_node *next = this->next;
223	// clock step
224	if(this != head) prev->next = next		// 若这是首节点，不存在prev节点
225	if(this != tail) next->prev = prev		// 若这是尾节点，不存在next节点
226	head = (head == this) ? next : head;
227	tail = (tail == this) ? prev : tail;
228	rt_node_cnt -= 1;
229	```

232	
233	伪代码如下，`size`​数组最终的值即为RT result

236	// FSM state init
237	#define DEPTH 2
238	unsigned size[DEPTH] = {0};
239	struct rt_node *ptr1 = NULL
240	struct rt_node *ptr2 = head;
241	
242	if(rt_node_cnt == 0){
243	    size[0] = MAXSIZE;
244	} else {
245	    for(unsigned cnt = 0; cnt <= rt_node_cnt; cnt++) {
246	        unsigned addr2 = (cnt == rt_node_cnt) ? MAXADDR : ptr2->addr1 - 1; 	// 这一空闲片段的最末地址

248	        unsigned thissize = addr2 - addr1;                                  // 这一空闲片段的大小
249	        // 如果组合逻辑链路过长，在这里clock step

253	        ptr2 = ptr2->next;

255	    }

265	# 代码说明
266	
267	## RT handler
268	
269	由主状态机统领全局，实现以下IO功能
270	
271	1. 接收`io.alloc`​请求
272	
273	    * 遍历链表，寻找合适的空闲资源片段
274	    * 输出找到的资源基址`io.baseaddr`​
275	    * 将新线程块写入链表
276	2. 接收`io.dealloc`​请求，从链表中删除对应项
277	3. 处理完一次alloc/dealloc事件后，遍历链表，找到最大的几个资源片段，更新Allocator中的RTcache（`io.rtcache_update`​）
278	4. ​`io.rtram_sel`​寻址到对应的RTram，`io.rtram_data`​读写数据
279	
280	辅助主状态机的硬件电路
281	
282	1. alloc/dealloc接收时机`ready`​
283	2. alloc/dealloc/scan三个子状态机与`io.rtram`​之间的双向MUX
284	
285	由主状态机控制的动作/子状态机
286	
287	1. alloc/dealloc请求被接收时存储新线程块的相关信息
288	2. handler更改目标CU时，控制RTram总线MUX
289	3. ALLOC子状态机
290	
291	    * 遍历链表，寻找合适的空闲资源片段（3级流水，需要n+2个周期，n为链表中线程块数量）
292	    * 输出找到的资源基址`io.baseaddr`​（等待握手）
293	    * 将新线程块写入链表（与上一条并行，固定需要2周期）
294	4. DEALLOC删除链表项（固定需要2周期）
295	5. SCAN子状态机（3级流水，需要n+2周期）
296	6. RTcache更新输出（等待握手）
297	
298	### ALLOC子状态机
299	
300	1. 关于遍历链表：
301	
302	    * 遍历链表的过程与SCAN过程完全类似，遍历结束后给出资源基址、待插入链表项的前后项指针、待插入链表项是否将成为首/尾节点
303	    * 由于RTram采用SyncReadMem实现，无法用组合逻辑读取，给出ptr后需要等待下一周期才能得到addr1与addr2数据，需要实现为多周期或流水线
304	    * 目前实现为三级流水，结构与SCAN状态机几乎完全相同，仅最后的流水级给出的结果不同
305	2. 有些线程块可能并不消耗某项资源，此时Alloc子状态机直接略过遍历链表这一步骤，也不会插入新链表项，直接输出一个随机的BaseAddr
306	
307	### SCAN子状态机
308	
309	三级流水线，但由主状态机控制，在原先设想的流水线结构上做了改进
310	
311	在SCAN状态下流水线正常运行，在非SCAN状态下流水线被停滞并为下一次SCAN做准备
312	
313	‍
314	
315	假设链表中共存在编号为`0 ~ (n-1)`​的线程块，则共需要检查`0 ~ n`​的资源片段，尽管部分资源片段的实际大小为0
316	
317	编号为`0`​的资源片段位于资源起始至首个线程块之间，编号为`n`​的资源片段位于最后一个线程块至资源末尾之间
318	
319	stage0寄存器中ptr1与ptr2是RTram SyncReadMem的输出，stage1寄存器中addr1, addr2是RTram SyncReadMem的输出
320	
321	自`fsm === FSM.SCAN`​的首个周期`cnt = 0`​起始：
322	
323	0. stage0的输出`DontCare`​，stage1实际读取`rtram.head`​作为ptr2，而`ptr1 = DontCare`​
324	1. stage0输出指向第`0, 1`​个线程块，stage1输出第`0`​个线程块的首地址，stage2计算第一个线程块前边的资源片段，并将size[0,1]的值Mux到0，stage2输出`DontCare`​
325	2. stage0输出指向第`1, 2`​个线程块，stage1输出第`0`​个线程块的末地址与第`1`​个线程块的首地址，stage2的输出更新到第0个资源片段
326	3. stage0输出指向第`2, 3`​个线程块，stage1输出第`1`​个线程块的末地址与第`2`​个线程块的首地址，stage2的输出更新到第1个资源片段

Based on my analysis of the codebase, here is the comprehensive report on the two subsystems:

---

## PART A — CTA Scheduler (Workgroup/Warp Dispatch)

### Main Modules

1. **`cta_scheduler_top`** (`ventus/src/cta/cta_scheduler.scala`)
   - Top-level module instantiating and connecting all CTA scheduler components
   - Interfaces: `host_wg_new`, `host_wg_done`, `cu_wf_new`, `cu_wf_done` for each CU

2. **`wg_buffer`** (`ventus/src/cta/wg_buffer.scala`)
   - Buffers workgroups from host using dual-port RAM (wgram1 for allocator, wgram2 for CU interface)
   - Round-robin selection using `RRPriorityEncoder`
   - Prevents duplicate WG submission via `wgram_alloc` tracking

3. **`allocator`** (`ventus/src/cta/allocator.scala`)
   - Resource table cache (RTcache) stores largest free resource segment sizes per CU
   - FSM states: `IDLE`, `CU_PREFER`, `RESOURCE_CHECK`, `ALLOC`, `REJECT`
   - Checks LDS/SGPR/VGPR availability, selects preferred CU

4. **`resource_table_top`** (`ventus/src/cta/resource_table.scala`)
   - Manages LDS/SGPR/VGPR allocation using linked lists per CU
   - Each WG slot stores: `prev`, `next`, `addr1`, `addr2` pointers
   - Handlers process alloc/dealloc/scan operations

5. **`cu_interface`** (`ventus/src/cta/cu_interface.scala`)
   - Splits WG into individual warps (WF) for sequential dispatch
   - Tracks completion via `wf_gather_cnt` and `wf_gather_ram`
   - FSM: `GET_WF`, `UPDATE`, `DEALLOC`

6. **`CTA2warp`** (`ventus/src/pipeline/CTA2warp.scala`)
   - SM-side interface receiving dispatched warps from CTA scheduler
   - Allocates warp IDs via `PriorityEncoder`

### Dispatch Flow: Host → WG Buffer → Resource Table → Allocator → CU

**What is a WG/WF?**
- **WG (Workgroup)**: CUDA thread block, contains multiple warps
- **WF (Wavefront)**: SIMD group of threads (32 threads per warp)

**Flow Sequence:**
1. Host sends WG to `wg_buffer` via `host_wg_new`
2. `wg_buffer` selects WG and sends to `allocator`
3. `allocator` checks resource availability using RTcache, iterates through CUs
4. If accepted, `resource_table` allocates base addresses (LDS/SGPR/VGPR)
5. `cu_interface` receives WG, splits into warps, dispatches one WF at a time to target CU
6. CU executes warp, returns `wf_done` to `cu_interface`
7. When all WFs complete, `cu_interface` triggers dealloc and notifies host

---

## PART B — Cache Hierarchy

### Main Modules

1. **`InstructionCache`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/ICache/ICache.scala`)
   - Top-level ICache with tag access, data SRAM, and MSHR
   - Interfaces: `coreReq`/`coreRsp` (to SM), `memReq`/`memRsp` (to L2/TLB)

2. **`DataCache`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala`)
   - More complex than ICache: handles writes, dirty bits, write-backs
   - Contains MSHR, WSHR (Write Status Holding Register), tag access with dirty tracking

3. **`SharedMemory`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/ShareMem/ShareMem.scala`)
   - On-chip shared memory with banked SRAM structure
   - `BankConflictArbiter` handles bank conflicts

4. **`L1TagAccess`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/L1TagAccess.scala`)
   - Tag memory access, hit detection, replacement policy
   - DCache version includes dirty bit tracking per way

5. **`MSHR`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/L1MSHR.scala`)
   - Tracks outstanding cache misses per entry with subentries
   - Handles primary misses (new block address) and secondary misses (same block, different offset)
   - Status codes: `PRIMARY_AVAIL`, `SECONDARY_AVAIL`, `PRIMARY_FULL`, etc.

6. **`L1Cache2L2Arbiter`** (`ventus/src/L1Cache/L1Cache2L2Arbiter.scala`)
   - Arbitrates between multiple L1 caches (ICache/DCache per SM)
   - Routes requests via `a_source` field encoding

7. **`Scheduler`** (`ventus/src/L2cache/Scheduler.scala`)
   - L2 cache scheduler with SourceA, SourceD, SinkA, SinkD modules
   - Directory-based inclusive cache
   - MSHR per entry for tracking L2 misses

8. **`BankedStore`** (`ventus/src/L2cache/BankedStore.scala`)
   - L2 data storage with banked SRAM organization
   - Handles inner/outer addresses with different mask widths

### Cache Hierarchy Relationships

**L1I/L1D/SharedMem to SM Pipeline:**
- `coreReq`: Request from SM (address, opcode, mask, per-lane data)
- `coreRsp`: Response to SM (data, active mask, instruction ID)
- `memReq`: Request to L2 (when cache miss)
- `memRsp`: Response from L2 (cache fill data)

**MSHR vs WSHR Roles:**
- **MSHR (Miss Status Holding Register)**: Tracks all outstanding cache misses (read/write). Organized as entries with subentries for multiple requests to same cache line. Handles merging of write requests to same line.
- **WSHR (Write Status Holding Register)**: DCache-specific, tracks pending write-backs to L2 to prevent ordering violations

**L2 Scheduler Connection:**
- Receives requests via `in_a` channel from L1Cache2L2Arbiter
- Uses directory for tag matching and coherence
- BankedStore provides data storage
- SourceD handles read data and write-back generation
